Hey folks,
**Mike Madrid** came back on the show and we didn't even make it to the first topic before we were deep into what this moment actually means -- Trump fatigue, the Epstein class, and whether something new is being forged in the wreckage of the last decade. We talked Prince Andrew. We talked corruption. And then we got into the numbers in Texas that should have Republicans sweating.
**What we got into:**
* [**00:01:07**] Mike Madrid jumps in and we start talking about strange bedfellows -- Joe Walsh, Thomas Massie, and the weird, hopeful coalition forming across party lines. Something is shifting. You can feel it.
* [**00:05:15**] The "Epstein class" conversation begins. Not left vs. right -- powerful vs. everyone else. We dig into what's being covered up and why accountability still feels out of reach.
* [**00:15:00**] Former Prince Andrew, arrests in the UK, and why it seems like Europe can hold elites accountable while America can't. We ask the uncomfortable question: how deep does this rot go?
* [**00:21:53**] I lay out what 2028 has to be about -- breaking the Epstein class, banning insider trading, and nominating leaders with the stomach to actually use power for working people.
* [**00:28:21**] Texas. Gerrymandering. A 31-point swing in a special election. We break down why Republicans may have overplayed their hand -- and how this map could explode in November.

This episode is about more than Prince Andrew or one Senate race. It's about whether we're at the end of a dark decade -- and what it would take to actually rebuild trust in this country. | **Momentum: Binkley Sweeps East Texans For Liberty Straw Poll**
---
On February 9th, The grassroots army in Upshur County just sent a loud message. Ryan Binkley is the clear choice for the 32nd District. Ryan went to Gilmer and secured a decisive victory at the East Texans For Liberty PAC straw poll. This was not just a win. It earned us the group's official endorsement. These are some of the most engaged patriots in the region. They saw the candidates side by side, and they picked the one with the right vision and the fire to win.Ryan said it best after the vote, “This victory belongs to the patriots who are tired of the status quo. It proves that when voters hear our message of faith and freedom, we win!”
---
| | **Leaked Poll Confirms Binkley is the Frontrunner**
---
They commissioned a poll to find a weakness, but they only confirmed our strength. A newly released survey from Texans For Strong Borders shows Ryan Binkley as the frontrunner in TX-32. This poll comes from a group supporting one of our opponents, and the numbers are devastating for them. The data puts Ryan in 1st Place with 16 percent of the vote. We have opened up a lead over Jace Yarbrough at 13 percent and Paul Bondar at 11 percent, while the rest of the field is stuck in single digits. The poll also reveals that Ryan has the highest favorability rating in the race. The voters know Ryan, and they trust him. While our opponents spend millions trying to introduce themselves, we are already pulling ahead.
---
|
---
| |
---
| **Building a True****Culture of Life**
---
** _By Ryan Binkley_**
---
| | We hear the phrase _Culture of Life_ thrown around in Washington as a political slogan. For me, it is not a slogan. It is a divine mandate. As a pastor and a father, I believe that life is a gift from God. But if we are going to be truly pro-life, we have to be honest about what that requires of us. For too long, the conversation has started and ended at the moment of birth. That is not enough. I was thankful when the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade because I believe in the value of every unborn child. But we cannot claim victory when so many children are still waiting for a home. Building a true Culture of Life means we must be as passionate about adoption as we are about the unborn. We have to make adoption easier and more affordable for American families. We have to fix a broken foster care system that leaves too many children without the love and comfort of a family.The radical Left pushes a culture of death that values convenience. We defeat that by showing them a better way. In Congress, I will fight to protect the unborn and ensure your tax dollars are NEVER used to fund abortions or abortion clinics. I will also fight to make sure that every child we save has a chance at a future. This is about more than policy. It is at the heart of our nation.**I choose life, and I hope you will join me in this fight.**

While our opponents spend millions trying to introduce themselves, we are already pulling ahead. | | | | Building a TrueCulture of Life By Ryan Binkley | | We hear the phrase Culture of Life thrown around in Washington as a political slogan. For me, it is not a slogan. It is a divine mandate. As a pastor and a father, I believe that life is a gift from God. But if we are going to be truly pro-life, we have to be honest about what that requires of us. For too long, the conversation has started and ended at the moment of birth. That is not enough. I was thankful when the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade because I believe in the value of every unborn child. But we cannot claim victory when so many children are still waiting for a home. Building a true Culture of Life means we must be as passionate about adoption as we are about the unborn. We have to make adoption easier and more affordable for American families. We have to fix a broken foster care system that leaves too many children without the love and comfort of a family.The radical Left pushes a culture of death that values convenience. We defeat that by showing them a better way. In Congress, I will fight to protect the unborn and ensure your tax dollars are NEVER used to fund abortions or abortion clinics. I will also fight to make sure that every child we save has a chance at a future. This is about more than policy. It is at the heart of our nation.I choose life, and I hope you will join me in this fight. | | | | | | | ---|---|---|--- | | Paid for by Ryan Binkley for Congress

I’m reaching out to a few proven patriots to ask for help. _**Your GOP profile has you marked as a TRUSTED MAGA INSIDER, so I know I can trust you.**_

name: Deb Haaland
subject: My friend Michael
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY DEB FOR NEW MEXICO**
body:
Michael will be a critical ally in the fight for our home the Mountain West

| | |
---
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5293?refcode=jtk374-bu-nd&t=1&akid=7588%2E400544%2E8gkf43)
Hi there, friend — it’s Deb Haaland.
As I continue meeting with communities across New Mexico and sharing my vision for our state as its next governor, I wanted to take a minute to tell you about my friend, Michael Bennet.
While I was Secretary of the Interior, Michael and I worked together extensively to secure hundreds of millions in funding to strengthen climate resilience, protect public lands, and reduce the risk of wildfires across Colorado’s communities.
**That's why he’s got my full support to be Colorado's next governor —[and why I’m reaching out in the hope that he and I can count on your support, too.](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5293?refcode=jtk374-bu-nd&t=2&akid=7588%2E400544%2E8gkf43)**
I grew up running through the desert, fishing with my dad, and walking the cornfields with my grandfather. They taught me that caring for our land and water is an act of service. When you protect the places people depend on, you are showing up for your community and taking responsibility for the future you leave behind.
When I first met Michael, I realized he felt that same sense of responsibility.
Michael first got my attention when he began fighting in the Senate to protect Colorado's Thompson Divide area from irresponsible drilling and mining in 2013. **He gave a voice to its trees, watersheds, and precious wildlife in the halls of power** — as well as the ranchers, conservationists, recreationists, and local and Tribal leaders who’d been fighting even longer. After more than a decade of his relentless advocacy, I was proud to sign the order banning extractive development across 222,000 acres of the region for the next 20 years.
Michael and I quickly became partners in the fight to protect our lands, our waters, and our rights. We’ve stood together in tough moments, taken on powerful interests, and delivered real results for the people we serve. We know what it means to be tested — especially when Donald Trump and his allies tried to roll back the progress we fought for — and we know what it takes to lead.
**That’s why I can’t think of a better partner to serve as governor of Colorado.**
But the truth is, the progress we made is at risk. Trump and his MAGA allies are working to gut environmental protections and open up public lands to the highest bidder, even as New Mexico and Colorado face the devastating impacts of climate change.
Right now, Democratic governors are the nation's first line of defense against Trump’s brazen attacks on our planet, our communities, and our economy.
Michael's campaign, like mine, is powered by grassroots supporters — **so if we’re going to keep building on the progress we made together, then _right now_ , friend, he needs you on his team.**
[**Will you please pitch in $5 or more today to split between Michael’s campaign and mine to power victory in Colorado's and New Mexico’s governors' races? With generous support from folks like you, together Michael and I can protect our lands and waters, keep showing up for our communities, and defend the rights and freedoms families in Colorado and New Mexico depend on.**](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5293?refcode=jtk374-bu-nd&t=3&akid=7588%2E400544%2E8gkf43)

Deb Haaland

Friend, it's Pete Buttigieg. I want to draw your attention to a race in Northwest Georgia that has the potential to bring a new kind of leadership for the district and help flip the U.S. House of Representatives. Stephen Colbert recorded a full segment to boost a Texas Senate candidate's campaign. Then he quietly pulled it. Now the candidate is claiming Trump censored him. That's a lie. [We break down exactly what happened](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=2060340597&e=567664f14c) — and then we get to the part that made Krysty pull up scripture in real time.

| |
🔥 **COLBERT TRIES TO BOOST TEXAS DEMOCRAT — HE PULLS THE SEGMENT**
James Talarico is running for U.S. Senate in Texas. Colbert gave him the full red carpet treatment. He killed the segment to dodge FCC equal-time rules — not because of Trump.
But Talarico posted it on YouTube anyway, claiming Trump didn't want you to see it.
Mark explains how the equal-time rule actually works. When you hear the real reason Colbert pulled it, you'll understand how cynical this whole thing is.

🚨 **SAME CANDIDATE USES THE STORY OF MARY TO JUSTIFY ABORTION**
This is the part that set Krysty off.
Talarico claims that because God asked for Mary's consent, the Bible supports abortion. He said it publicly. To millions of listeners.
Krysty pulls up three specific verses. Mark connects it to Rubio's speech on God-given rights. When you hear the scripture next to what this guy claims — the distortion is breathtaking.

💰 **TAX REFUNDS UP 11% — AND A NEW POLL THE MEDIA'S BURYING**
The IRS just released new numbers. We break down what the Big Beautiful Bill is putting back in your wallet — and a Morning Consult poll that shows which party Americans actually trust on the issues that matter most.
The top of that list is going to make a lot of people uncomfortable.

😢 **TOM HOMAN BREAKS DOWN ON CAMERA**
They found a 14-year-old girl. Pregnant. Living with two adult male traffickers.
Homan tells the story on C-SPAN — then talks about the 9-year-old he held that he'll never forget. This is the clip the media won't play. We do.

Peter, Apparently, I’m “unelectable.” At least that’s what a Fox News pundit said recently when talking about my campaign. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125739913/602770292/949478007?refcode=em-2.19.26-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMTc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzdiN2I1N2ItZjMwZC1mMTExLWE2OWEtMDAwZDNhNTc1OTNmIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=YC151lOSOnY5-y_TWevuNRopoARjn8lIq9-p1fuR7go=) __This is Andrew Cuomo’s top aide and strategic advisor by the way...__ Well that settles it, folks. Unelectable because I believe health care is a right.

subject: I’ve been all over Texas
body:
[1]LeftNet

Hi,

I’ve been all over Texas, recruiting candidates across the ballot, raising
volunteers for our voter registration work, and working with those
volunteers to register and stay in touch with new voters across the state.

Meeting folks who are stepping into the fight for the first time, joining
old friends who’ve been there from the beginning, and talking with new
voters to understand their perspectives and what it will take to bring
more of them into the next election – all of that makes me feel confident
that what we’re doing is key to winning big elections in Texas in 2026.

There’s a place for consultants, pollsters, social media, and TV (I
guess), but that’s not us. Powered by People is focused on meeting people
where they’re at, showing them the respect they deserve, and working with
them to overcome the most intense voter suppression in the country so that
we can win power back for the people.

But (you knew this part was coming): we can’t do this without you. This
movement is going to take all of us, the organizer, the volunteer, the
voter, and you.

I’d like to show all those volunteers out there the kind of support we’ve
built behind them. Every dollar keeps us on the ground, helps us bring new
voters onto the rolls, and ensures that we can do the essential work
needed for 2026 and beyond.

# [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=240697%2E444211%2E26toyY)
I met Lauren at the University of North Texas on Tuesday when she made the decision to get registered to vote with one of our Powered by People volunteers. When asked “why today,” here’s what she had to say:
_“Last election, I didn’t vote. I feel very regretful towards that, especially with everything that’s going on now. So, today was a step in the right direction by getting registered to vote, and making that change for myself.”_
[__](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/67576?t=3&akid=240697%2E444211%2E26toyY)
The truth is, if our volunteers hadn’t been there, Lauren and every other student we met might not have taken that step. This is what Powered by People does. It’s not flashy, but it’s the work that works.
I told Lauren, _“It’s never too late to do the right thing. It doesn’t matter whether you voted before or missed an election or voted for somebody that you regret voting for. You can still do the right thing right now.”_
Here’s the proof: statewide, young people turned out at 37% in 2024. Those in our program? Over 79%. That’s the difference one conversation, one text, one check-in can make.
[**Right now, our country is at a serious tipping point, and if we’re going to have a shot come November, we need to be out there, on the ground, registering and turning out voters across Texas. Will you chip in $3 to keep this work going?**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260219.ensImn&refcode=ema20260219-240697&t=4&akid=240697%2E444211%2E26toyY)

Beto

Our right to vote has never been more important. We've never truly faced threats like this before, and with the midterms coming up fast we have to do everything possible to combat voter suppression, register voters, and ensure we actually have free and fair elections to vote in.

That was Donald Trump, Team, speaking to members of his party in the House of Representatives on the 5th anniversary of his supporters storming the Capitol to overturn an election he lost.

Derek,
Making America great doesn’t mean telling people _they’re not wanted here_. It means saying, _“The ambitions of this country would be incomplete without your help.”_
That’s the vision of America we’ve inherited from people who pushed for better. They knew — just as you do — that America was big enough for them, too.
It’s what allows me — the son of a remarkable immigrant single mom, and someone who felt handcuffs on my wrists at 11 years old — to write to you now as the first Black governor in Maryland’s history.
Democrats like me are fighting to make things more affordable, to make our public schools better, to protect our rights and freedoms, and so much more. But the truth is, there are a lot of people who disagree with us in this moment. Leaders who measure America’s greatness by how many it keeps out, rather than how many it lifts up.
**Democratic governors, mayors, members of Congress, attorneys general, and state legislators are the last line of defense in this moment. And we need your help to take even more seats this year.**

I'll be blunt, Fellow Patriot. If we allow procedure to protect politicians instead of protecting our elections, then we're part of the problem. | | Dear Friend, Here's a question for you: **what 's rare in human history but essential to freedom?**

The answer is **citizenship**.

This isn't a riddle...you can easily discover why citizenship is vital by **claiming your FREE DVD box set **of Hillsdale College's course, **" American Citizenship and Its Decline," taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson using this secure link:
****
[https://info.hillsdale.edu/free-american-citizenship-dvd](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4uvbo4s20ucsdjnt134dorqluapd5ub6dkh0i9o_rp22sh2s8i6epr4clgeaoj1c9h2bs)**

---
| | For too long, unelected elites have chipped away at the rule of American citizens--replacing self-government with open borders and control by a ruling class unaccountable to the people.

As someone who loves this country, I know that weighs on you--it troubles me too. That's why this course matters.

**Victor Davis Hanson **traces the history of citizenship from ancient Greece and Rome to the American founding--and shows how we can restore it before it's lost.

In eight fascinating lectures, you'll explore:

* The erosion of the middle class and self-rule
* The disappearance of sovereign borders
* The rise of tribalism and the “deep state”
* Modern assaults on the Constitution and freedom

This course will open your eyes to the challenges we face--and inspire you to help defend liberty.

Please don't wait. Supplies are limited.

**Claim your free DVD box set of "American Citizenship and Its Decline" today using this secure link:**

[https://info.hillsdale.edu/free-american-citizenship-dvd](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z101sb6cq1n5uela088vuacl68orgeqmomi9ektg_rp22sh2s8i6epr4clgeaoj1c9h2bs)

Citizenship truly is rare in history--and essential to freedom. I hope you'll take this opportunity to explore its meaning and importance through this FREE DVD box set.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

**Justin Story Praises VA for Halting Medication-Based Disability Rule and Restoring Veterans’ Second Amendment Rights** __

_**“Veterans deserve policies that honor their service, protect their freedoms, and ensure fair compensation without unnecessary penalties. Today’s actions by the VA on both fronts show real progress in putting veterans first.” **__**—**_**Justin Story**
---
|
---
| | February 20, 2026Contact: [Justin@VoteJustinStory.com](mailto:justin@votejustinstory.com?subject=&body=)
---
| |

**ST. CLOUD, FL** — Justin Story, Republican candidate for Congress in Florida’s 9th Congressional District and retired U.S. Marine Corps officer, today applauded two significant recent decisions by the Department of Veterans Affairs: the restoration of Second Amendment rights for veterans in the Fiduciary Program and the immediate halt to enforcement of the controversial interim final rule on “Evaluative Rating: Impact of Medication.”On February 17, 2026, the VA announced it would end its decades-old practice of reporting veterans who need assistance managing their VA benefits (via the Fiduciary Program) to the FBI’s National Instant Criminal Background Check System (NICS) as prohibited persons for firearm ownership. This change corrects a longstanding injustice that deprived thousands of veterans of their constitutional rights without due process or evidence of danger. The VA is also working to remove past erroneous reports, restoring rights to those affected.Story praised this as a major win for veterans’ freedoms:“This is exactly the kind of common-sense reform we need. Veterans who served to defend our Constitution should never lose their own rights under it simply because they need help with finances. Ending this unfair policy respects due process, upholds the Second Amendment, and shows leadership that prioritizes veterans over bureaucracy.”Additionally, on February 19, 2026, VA Secretary Doug Collins announced the immediate halt to enforcement of the interim final rule (effective February 17) that would have required disability ratings to reflect functional improvement from medication or treatment, potentially lowering compensation for veterans whose symptoms are better managed while medicated. The decision came amid widespread concerns from veterans’ organizations and advocates that the rule could penalize those seeking treatment and fail to account for the full, unmedicated burden of service-connected conditions.While acknowledging the intent to base ratings on actual daily functioning, Story welcomed the halt as a responsible step:“I’m glad the VA listened to veterans’ voices and paused this change. Normalcy for many isn’t achieved through lifelong medication. Prolonged use can lead to side effects, reduced effectiveness over time, tolerance issues, and other challenges. Disability evaluations should reflect the true impact of service-connected conditions, not create disincentives for treatment or undervalue underlying severity. This halt protects earned benefits and ensures veterans aren’t caught in a system that discourages getting the help they need.”Story emphasized that both actions reflect positive momentum under current leadership but stressed the need for ongoing vigilance:“Florida’s veterans and military families have given everything for our country. They deserve a VA that defends their rights, fairly compensates their sacrifices, and avoids policies with unintended harms. In Congress, I will continue fighting to protect constitutional freedoms, secure veterans’ benefits, and always put American heroes first.”Justin Story is a retired U.S. Marine Corps officer, husband, father, and sixth-generation Central Floridian running for Congress in Florida’s 9th Congressional District.For learn more about Justin and his campaign, visit [VoteJustinStory.com](https://votejustinstory.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=aa75fb334e8c06de90a8e46d5&id=6f3482cd12&e=90ad5fc3c5) or contact [justin@votejustinstory.com](mailto:justin@votejustinstory.com?subject=&body=). ###

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | | 220 Executive Orders in just one year. subject: CVS, CVS, CVS, and CVS.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
One giant company is usually in charge of the whole supply chain

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2784%2E4032634%2Eo2vN3W)
---
Imagine you wake up with a headache. It’s a fairly common experience (especially these days), and one that shouldn’t accidentally put you in the middle of a web of corporate greed. But it does. Let's say you go to the doctor. And it's Oak Street Health because that’s close by. Well, Oak Street Health is owned by CVS. That’s right — your doctor is _**owned**_ by CVS. And let’s say that doctor prescribes you medicine. So you go to your pharmacy, CVS. That medicine is covered by your insurance, Aetna. And who owns Aetna? Right again, CVS. But wait, there's a middleman between your pharmacy and insurance company that helps you negotiate prices to lower costs: CVS Caremark. Who owns the middleman? You got it — CVS. CVS may own your pharmacy. CVS may own your doctor. CVS may own your insurance company. CVS may own the middleman between your insurance company and your pharmacy. One giant company is in charge of the whole supply chain, and you better believe they are taking a cut every step of the way. That means prices get higher and higher, and patients left paying more and more. To fix our country’s inflating health care crisis, we have to break up big medicine once and for all. By doing that, we will lower health care costs for you and your family. And I have a bipartisan bill to get that done. [**Add your name today to be a grassroots co-sponsor of the Break Up Big Medicine Act. Look, it’s not just CVS.
If you use United Health Group for insurance, you may have had to deal with a pharmacy benefit manager called Optum RX, which is supposed to negotiate prescription drug benefits and decide which drugs are covered by United.
Guess who owns Optum RX? United Health Group. They also own Optum, which is a health services company.
Just as health care prices are set to spike this year following Trump's Big, Ugly Bill, this corporate consolidation ensures that a handful of companies are set up to profit even more.
When our bipartisan bill becomes law, companies that operate as one giant health conglomerate and violate the rules must comply within a year, and regulators, state attorneys general, and even private citizens can take action to enforce the rules.
For decades, policies have encouraged these mega-mergers, letting companies stack the deck to maximize profits while Americans pay more for worse care. We’re finally taking steps to level the playing field.

subject: This is about more than just me

body:
It’s about the rights of every person in this country. I didn’t get shot at and launch into orbit to see freedom of speech in the United States end on my watch.
#

Team,
Trump and Hegseth are coming after everything I worked for over 25 years in the Navy and NASA.
That’s true.
But this is about more than just me. It’s about the rights of every person in this country.
I didn’t get shot at and launch into orbit to see freedom of speech in the United States end on my watch.
I am not going to be silenced. I am going to fight them tooth and nail over this. I won’t let them make an example out of me, and I absolutely won’t let them intimidate everyone else.
Ain’t gonna happen.
But to win against these bullies I need a couple of things.
First off, I need a massive team from coast-to-coast that’s not afraid and is ready to speak out against Trump.
And second, we’re going to need to raise a significant amount of resources — not just to fight Hegseth and what he’s trying to do to me, but to protect the rights of every American. To take back our majorities in Congress and reign in this President. To defend our democracy and our Constitution, just like I swore an oath to do 40 years ago.
I don’t need you to chip in to every email I send, but I am hoping you might give to this one.
[**So, if any of that is worth $5 or $10 to you, please: Make a donation.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-feb26-dod.ieOg55&refcode=em260210-1-90&t=1&akid=6371%2E6688874%2Er3IQRA)

Thank you for your courage.
Mark

## Trump: Iran Decision in 10 Days
President Trump said Thursday the outcome of nuclear talks with Iran will be decided [over the next "probably 10 days](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHS2yAQhJ8GdeeBE1i_Coo06v60KTVIHBYxAg2c7ejtM8orpN6Zb_fbX9_zt4sp5sdPt5PlUOZMn5aImeocq8uenE8x06t9yk65bWV90owS7yARUM7exXTOuvM2ECH1HVk1DMqMg0LsNhvuCvvlyyyazIpGaxPGUWo3rkugYfRdtBdNIkql1ZdWNwo4oFFr6NH4YILQknzkUm-_S8y8UUhneVO9rWXvkt2Yjyb6HwIngVM-j9L4igROF1jgJFHgpEaB06vB5SdwOiq16CkzcH3tBzR3NnAZLmdwzG59gqc1tlgypPikdMJVCrwRZPrDcNSyuCWdoCR4d17Qrlp_fGJKsd0HoeVjdzH9m8n_9e3b4t8AAAD__35Rjk0)," as the Pentagon deploys one of the largest military buildups into the region since the 2003 invasion of Iraq. Two aircraft carriers, 13 warships, F-22 Raptors, F-15s, and dozens of fighter jets are converging on the Middle East, with full forces expected in place by mid-March. Iran and Russia responded by [launching joint naval drills ](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOtCAUBeCnwQ4Dd1DHguJv7OZvtzQIl_HuIBjAMfP2G_cVtj7Jd3LO12N-GAoUn__Nhrr6NEc8S8BaMc-UTXRoXKCIRznThrGsyb5wBgE9F8BBzM5Q-MyqcdojAt4a1HIYZDcOEqBZdXd3uIwL9ALMaOXYi06hskr5URmr7g3pSxMAQip5V7JFDwN00vobdM53nimBjmrK7XeiWFf04ZPemFubtibotda9sNs_BhOD6TzP1sbFXiGD6aIZTAIYTHJkMNV8bDs_Cr_G8XjYgCbzasKr8ESB75ksFp6PUsi0a91Ck7XbTwqBSj8wJZ6bofDbXf902FvDTwAAAP__opx-1g)in the Sea of Oman Thursday. Officials told Trump the military could be ready for strikes as early as this weekend, though no final decision has been made.
## Board of Peace Pledges Billions for Gaza
President Trump convened the [inaugural Board of Peace meeting](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQRb8GOiN7AnFSuNgmXbbdEg32GGZjbGSbsNmvf-L9wmvvla7uOX-e4xM5cJx_40qm-jRGOkqgWimPnDE6Qhc40l6OtFIsS7IvGkHCVUgQIEeHHD5j3zrjiYAuLRmltRruWgG0i3F3PYDWzqppIMCrvE29v90tDbaXDrBlc65JAKl6detVRx40DMr6CwzOD77pJTmuKXd_E8e6kA-f9Kbc2bS2wSy1bqW5_Grg0cDjOI7Op38nxdmfScrBNfDYoyhk98z1I2zao-Ug1vQmUagUTlHM-B_FQaWKCeNL4ELoRM37uhXBEfd5zxjElDA7sRFaEitR5Ti32bjt4BC4XHXTy3lFDt_v6o-Uvg18BQAA__9cP49P) on Thursday in Washington, where nine member nations pledged $7 billion toward Gaza reconstruction, and the U.S. committed an additional $10 billion. Five countries, including Indonesia, pledged troops for a 20,000-soldier international stabilization force. Plans presented at the meeting include adding 400,000 new homes, $30 billion in infrastructure, and a [FIFA-funded $72 million soccer complex](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL-OnjAQxJ_GdKD18sdQuEjj7tKmRHt4_eHE2Mj2fYg8fURe4aqZYjQz-v36WD_IBx9fP-lgXV1aI18lcK2cV58pWiYbfOSvcqWDY9nT9odXBJxawBZhteTDvQ6N1Y4ZuW9YS6XkuCiJ2Ox6AmXVtkxjDwyDQiDol36kuVfL-AnUeP20ASLIQc6D7NihwlFursfRutGJAdj6mnL3O_lYd3bhTm_O3ZaOJui91rOI_odAI9Bc19V9FarJ0v0EBJpSU74fPVOu5TFp2zgLNM-wQAMo0MhFoHHeUevjm0s9ONb2RX-p_UyUbZtcezJtLNDMs5pQTgCgBJoma3tePgRfJiUGeB3kw_9v9VtA3xr_BQAA__9rOYaG) featuring a stadium seating up to 25,000. Trump also warned Hamas it would be "harshly met" if it doesn't disarm, while Israel set a 60-day deadline for the group to surrender its weapons. [Follow live updates here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGS3CAQRU8jZUxBC42WgMCJsnXqUNWCZtQ2AhUwo1qf3qUJfIGNu_-r_9-vz-UTOXJ6_MSdbAt5SXTWSK1RWbhg8oQ-cqJnPfNOqW7Z_aEFJNyFBAFy8cjxa9G9t4EIaOjJqmlSo5kUQL9Zb9AY5wKaDy_NndZhkDqsE4YQnNGyZ3vRJIBUWn1odaMAE4zKhQFGH8bQaUmeWy6335lT2yjEr_yicnN576PdWjtqN_zoYO5gPs_zllZ3rbjuHcxHjtzY1Q7mVp77IdDvnLi2go1z6mCO_CKxxvz4_7JmLF4chI7EA_-iuFQIv1XBjgRFcle0CjpqI07iTXgeHhtVUVxCGI2Sui_WHyfHyPU-dVo-duT4rt2-5fpl4V8AAAD___Wvl5w).
## Former Prince Andrew Arrested
Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor, the former British royal prince and King Charles's younger brother, was [arrested on Thursday](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuwyAURb_G3rDgBcfpwNDFW7p2tAg84tdisOA5NH9fpb_Q-UpX55zP63K1FCndP-yGhkNeErYakRnLQsUmj9ZHSnjUljdMdc3uGxeQcBYSBMjFW4rPRffeBETAU49GTZMa3yYF0K9GgpZO6bMGsGidk_5yk9NlDHJ0KK3uybzeJIBUWl20GjDABKNy4QSjD2PotERPnMvwlSnxiiE-8wPL4PLWR7My77U7vXcwdzC31oaQf14Wr72DGRNjYUtpw8QdzDb5gk1s-Uh8s8yYRKPkay7CloKV0Yt61J0c5SQ2qi4nfzgW-3GL5EQOgRz2xfi9UYxUz1On5X2zFP-I-F8ZHwZ-AwAA___blot9) on suspicion of misconduct in public office, making him the first senior British royal in modern history to be arrested. The charge carries a maximum sentence of life in prison. The arrest stems from emails uncovered in the [Epstein files released by the Department of Justice](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuwyAQQL8Gb0RwMcEdGLp4S9eOFjFHfCkGCy6x_PdV-gudn_Se9L6v09VTonz_8is6jmXKuLeEzFgnqj4H9CFRxmfby4q5LWX-wQkUXKQCCWoKntIx9V1wERHw3KHT1mrzYTVAt7g5DlEbfYt4U8M8mNCrQRtjweoA2tqO3NumAJTu9dDrE0awYPQcz2BCNFH0CgNxqadHocwLxnSUF9bTXNYuuYV5a-L8KWAUMPKCC6X0ZgLGrSSaDwEjZcaaPVPJPgkYfQ4Vd7mWZ-abZ8Ysd8qhlSp9rdgYg3xgjBUPiVtjpCxg7KoL204pUbtY0av76ukv1fG_3r0c_AYAAP__DtmF2Q) last month, which appear to show the former prince forwarding confidential British trade reports to convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein in 2010, while serving as Britain's special envoy for international trade. He also allegedly shared a confidential brief on investment opportunities in Afghanistan. Andrew, who turned 66 on Thursday, was released under investigation after 11 hours in custody. King Charles responded with a statement saying the law "must take its course." The former prince has denied all wrongdoing. [Follow live updates here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGO6yAUheHV4C4WXGMTCorXuMtrp0QELvFNMESYCcruR5ktTH2kTzr_18VeHCXKt_9uR9NisRn7kbA1rJaqywFdSJTx--hlx3xsxT_QAoflxOEE3AZH6W3lEExEBJwGNEIpMWslAIbNRKcnqQWCnuW0zADopgXOwqFefJRuIPPROAAXUpylGDGCgln4OMEc4hyZ5BiolTreC-W2YUzv8sI6-rIPyWytPQ82_WOwMlh77-P16j8bg_VzhsGa6IUMVq_44151v3fehmrCs1NKdCyKSX7bHaVfsf0pw8vATwAAAP__Wb9wZA).

On this day in 1962, became the first American to orbit the Earth aboard Project Mercury’s Friendship 7 spacecraft, which circled the globe three times in a flight lasting 4 hours, 55 minutes, and 23 seconds. Yesterday, at the Olympics, American women won two gold medals: a thrilling overtime hockey win over Canada, and , ending a 20-plus-year U.S. gold drought in the women’s individual event. Today’s sponsor, , is offering a free copy of Hearts of Fire 2 , a powerful collection of true stories highlighting courageous women who stood firm in their faith despite intense persecution worldwide. | Trump: Iran Decision in 10 Days President Trump said Thursday the outcome of nuclear talks with Iran will be decided ," as the Pentagon deploys one of the largest military buildups into the region since the 2003 invasion of Iraq. Two aircraft carriers, 13 warships, F-22 Raptors, F-15s, and dozens of fighter jets are converging on the Middle East, with full forces expected in place by mid-March. Iran and Russia responded by the Sea of Oman Thursday. Officials told Trump the military could be ready for strikes as early as this weekend, though no final decision has been made. Board of Peace Pledges Billions for Gaza President Trump convened the on Thursday in Washington, where nine member nations pledged $7 billion toward Gaza reconstruction, and the U.S. committed an additional $10 billion. Five countries, including Indonesia, pledged troops for a 20,000-soldier international stabilization force. Plans presented at the meeting include adding 400,000 new homes, $30 billion in infrastructure, and a featuring a stadium seating up to 25,000. Trump also warned Hamas it would be "harshly met" if it doesn't disarm, while Israel set a 60-day deadline for the group to surrender its weapons. . Former Prince Andrew Arrested Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor, the former British royal prince and King Charles's younger brother, was on suspicion of misconduct in public office, making him the first senior British royal in modern history to be arrested. The charge carries a maximum sentence of life in prison. The arrest stems from emails uncovered in the last month, which appear to show the former prince forwarding confidential British trade reports to convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein in 2010, while serving as Britain's special envoy for international trade. He also allegedly shared a confidential brief on investment opportunities in Afghanistan. Andrew, who turned 66 on Thursday, was released under investigation after 11 hours in custody. King Charles responded with a statement saying the law "must take its course." The former prince has denied all wrongdoing. . body:

name: Patrick J. Murphy
subject: Lent, Leadership, and the Discipline of Restraint
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP25/1/106220/images/PJM_Logo.png]
Every year around this time, people ask what I’m giving up for Lent.
The easy answers for most are chocolate, alcohol, social media - giving up cursing is always at the top of my list but I unfortunately my Irish temper (especially when driving) too often gets in the way. The harder question is why Lent exists at all, and whether it’s even useful for people who've never set foot in a church.
Lent comes from the Old English word lencten , meaning springtime. In the Christian tradition, it marks the 40 days before Easter, modeled on Jesus' 40 days in the desert — a season of preparation through fasting, prayer, and almsgiving.
The structure is ancient, but I've come to believe that preparing oneself to get better themselves is important for anyone willing to improve, regardless of where they stand on faith.
This year, Lent coincides with Ramadan, when Muslims around the world fast from dawn to sunset as a discipline of spiritual focus and gratitude. Different traditions, but a shared human instinct to pause, reset, and begin again.
Traditionally, fasting meant giving up food - including giving up meat on Fridays. But the deeper meaning is restraint. Because Lent isn't really about deprivation. It's about the harder discipline of choosing to live with les — less consumption, less noise, less ego — in order to see more clearly and strengthen character.
In a culture that rewards excess, the conscious choice to make a sacrifice is powerful. It doesn't require a faith tradition to recognize why.
The Power of Restraint
In the military, restraint is strength. The most dangerous leader is not the one who lacks discipline to say no or hold back. The truly dangerous ones lack self-control and let power go their heads.
Anyone can escalate a conflict. It takes discipline to de-escalate. Anyone can respond in anger. It takes leadership to pause.
Today we live in a constant reaction cycle. Social media algorithms reward outrage. Cable news rewards immediacy. Politics rewards performance.
What would it mean to fast from that?
What would it look like if leaders fasted from personal attacks for 40 days? If we restrained the instinct to respond instantly - especially if its not a positive response?
Prayer: The Discipline of Reflection
The second pillar of Lent is prayer.
For those who do not practice faith, translate that word as reflection.
Prayer is not simply speaking. It is listening. It is silence. It is stepping back from the noise long enough to discern what actually matters.
In Iraq, moments of pause often mattered more than moments of action. Rushed decisions compound risk in ways that are hard to undo. Reflection sharpens judgment. Our rules of engagement were clear - we were to shoot and shoot to kill veterans of Mass once we saw a hostile act or hostile intent. One night at our forward operating base, we heard scattered gunshots hitting our permitter wall. I was on the rooftop with a dozen other shoulders looking out in the dead of night, waiting to see a muzzle flash or silhouette, my face pressed against the concrete ledge, my M4 rifle on fire, the meat of my index finger on the trigger - but I never fired - nor did my fellow paratroopers - because we didn’t see where the earlier gunshots came from and shooting back into the city streets of Baghdad would probably meant innocents dying. It was a powerful lesson of restraint from some of the most elite soldiers i had the honor of serving in the company with.
Yet our public culture rarely rewards reflection or restraint. We reward constant commentary. We mistake visibility on national television for leadership.
Lent challenges that assumption. It insists that silence can strengthen us. That clarity is built in quiet spaces.
Leaders who cannot sit in silence often cannot see clearly.
Almsgiving: Service Over Self
The third pillar is almsgiving — traditionally, giving to those in need.
At its core, this is about service.
When I first entered political public service after being an independent most of my life, I learned quickly that titles do not make you important. Responsibility does and so does the willingness to put someone else's needs ahead of your own comfort by moving the ball forward for them, usually at a large scale.
Veterans and athletes understand this instinctively. You are trained to put the mission and the team ahead of yourself. That mindset does not disappear when the uniform comes off.
In a culture that increasingly measures success by followers, visibility, and personal brand, Lent asks a different question:
Who are you serving?
Not what are you building for yourself. Not what are you broadcasting. Who are you helping through your actions (or non-action)?
What would it mean for a nation to observe Lent - or at least to purposely reflect?
This is not a call for religious revival. It is a call for discipline.
Imagine if for 40 days:
Politicians fasted from personal attacks.
Media organizations fasted from amplifying generated outrage.
Leaders fasted from self-promotion.
Citizens fasted from instant judgment.
Imagine if we practiced restraint, reflection, and service — not as slogans, but as habits.
Spring is a season of renewal. But renewal requires preparation.
In the Christian tradition, the 40 days in the desert preceded the resurrection. The discomfort precedes the clarity of purpose.
Lent reminds us that strength is not built in comfort. It is built in intentional limitation.
This year, I am less interested in what I am giving up and more interested in what I am building: greater restraint in how I respond, deeper reflection before I decide, and clearer focus on who I serve.
Whether you observe Lent or not, the discipline behind it is worth considering.
Because in a moment defined by noise, outrage, and excess, restraint might be the most countercultural act of leadership we have left.
- Patrick
Be sure to follow me on Instagram [https://www.instagram.com/patrickmurphypa/?hl=en] and subscribe to my Substack [https://substack.com/@patrickmurphypa] for my weekly geopolitical and business analysis .

| Letter from the Chair
---
Countdown to March 2: Nebraska Republicans Gear Up for 2026 Victories!
We're in the final countdown to March 2 -- the filing deadline for new (non-incumbent) candidates to join the 2026 races. All incumbents planning to run -- whether for their current office or a new one -- had to file by February 17th. There are some exceptions including ESU's and Power Boards under 40 million; the filing deadline for those are in August. Am I the only one ready to breathe a huge sigh of relief once the full candidate slates are set for every race?
A massive hat tip to Joe Hagerty, our NEGOP Political Director. Joe has been relentless -- like a dog with a bone -- in recruiting strong Republicans for legislative seats, utilities, NRDs, community colleges, and beyond. He's built prospect lists, hosted recruitment events, and powered through thousands of calls to find willing, able candidates. When someone shows interest, he moves fast, providing a tailored list of open offices based on their address. Building and keeping a deep bench is key to our long-term success, and Joe's efforts are making a real difference.
We've also ramped up training to equip our candidates and teams:
Multiple campaign schools Social media training Grassroots organizing sessions
All were well-attended and highly effective. The Leadership Institute and Republican National Committee provided very effective campaign and leadership trainings. The social media training was very popular and special thanks to Haile McAnally our Communications Director, Attorney General Mike Hilgers and Flyover Strategies for leading that outstanding program. More trainings will be forthcoming.
One bright spot this cycle: fewer Republican-vs.-Republican races -- and that makes me very happy. With so many critical positions needing solid GOP candidates, it's far better to avoid intra-party battles when possible. Contested primaries will always happen, but we've taken steps to minimize unnecessary ones.
Thanks to the NEGOP State Central Committee's vote in August 2025, the party maintains neutrality in R-vs-R races. That means when only one Republican files in a race, our NEGOP officers can personally endorse and support that candidate right after the filing window closes -- a huge advantage for unified momentum heading into the primary.
In contested R-vs-R primaries, we'll wait until voters choose the nominee before offering personal endorsements. The same applies in non-partisan races where R-vs-R could extend to the general election.
We have plenty of key races to rally around, with these leading the pack:
Senator Pete Ricketts' re-election Governor Jim Pillen's re-election Brinker Harding's bid for CD2
Each will face challenges, but every Republican in these races is a far stronger choice than any Democrat or "Independent" opponent. Together, we'll make sure voters see that clearly -- and deliver wins across the board.
Stay tuned as the field finalizes over the next couple of weeks. Let's keep the energy high, the recruitment strong, and the focus on victory.
For Nebraska, Mary Jane Truemper Chairman, Nebraska Republican Party

Dear Fellow American,

Chicago Public Schools desperately needs qualified teachers. But school officials are choosing to discriminate against Christian student teachers rather than fill those vacancies.

The students at Moody Bible Institute are experiencing this discrimination firsthand.

Moody's students are barred from participating in Chicago Public School's student-teaching program. Not because they lack qualifications. Not because they lack passion for serving students. But because Moody exclusively hires staff who affirm and live out its biblical beliefs.

**In other words, Chicago Public Schools is punishing Moody students for attending a college that practices its faith.**

This is an attack on religious freedom--one of the foundational freedoms that has shaped our nation since its inception. Religious schools like Moody Bible Institute have the constitutional right to exclusively hire employees who share their faith and uphold their religious mission. Without this right, religious institutions would lose their very identity and purpose.

Moody's mission is clear: proclaim the gospel and equip people to be biblically grounded, practically trained, and to engage the world through gospel-centered living. For that mission to be credible, its faculty and staff must be unified in both belief and practice.

But when Moody requested a simple religious exemption acknowledging its constitutionally protected rights, the district refused.

**Instead, officials doubled down --effectively telling Moody students that their faith disqualifies them from serving Chicago's public school children.**

Alliance Defending Freedom is representing Moody Bible Institute in a federal lawsuit to challenge this discriminatory exclusion.

**Will you sign our Statement of Support for Moody Bible Institute and stand with them in this critical moment?
**
This isn't an isolated situation. We are watching this pattern repeat nationwide.

In Washington State, **Yakima Union Gospel Mission** serves thousands of homeless individuals every day--offering food, shelter, and the hope of Christ to locals who desperately need it. Yet the state is threatening the Mission because it only hires those who share its Christian beliefs. Now the Mission is in court seeking to protect its right to hire those who share and live out its faith.

Similarly, in Oregon, Youth 71Five Ministries is asking an appeals court to protect its right to receive public benefits without having to give up its right to employ those who share its faith. Youth 71Five Ministries serves at-risk youth, empowering them with the hope of the Gospel. It depends on a staff that shares its biblical beliefs. But officials stripped the ministry of its public funding for only hiring like-minded individuals who ensure that mission goes forward, violating its constitutional freedoms.

When ministries like Moody, Yakima Union Gospel Mission, and Youth 71Five Ministries stand up in court, they are not only protecting their own freedom. They are defending religious freedom and free expression for every American--Christian or not.

**But these battles come with real emotional and personal costs.** Leaders and staff can face hostility, intense public scrutiny, and even open threats. Stand alongside thousands of believers who are praying for Moody during these stressful times.

That's why your voice matters so deeply right now.

**Please take a moment to sign the Statement of Support today.**

As the daughter of a Pueblo woman, I was taught the value of hard work from a very young age.

My mother was born and raised in a train boxcar, where the Laguna people built a community far from their home. She proudly served in the U.S. Navy, raised four kids as a military wife, and devoted more than two decades to Indian education at the Bureau of Indian Affairs.

I am blessed to come from generations of resilient and fierce Pueblo women – **and I am the person, mother, and leader I am today because of them.**
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/4657?refcode=jtk380-fr-nd&t=3&akid=7608%2E400544%2EdhtdVv)
**But getting here wasn't easy, friend, and the hard work and resilience I learned proved essential.
**
Like many New Mexicans, I know what it’s like to struggle. I was a single mom living paycheck to paycheck, relying on government programs like SNAP, WIC, and Medicaid to help keep my child fed and healthy. **Every day, as hard as it was, I had to get back up and keep going.
**
But my struggle made me fierce. It fortified my resolve to build a brighter future – not only for my child, _but for every family dreaming of and fighting for a better life._

That's why I decided to run for office in 2018. _And I won._ I became one of the first Native American women elected to Congress, and in 2021, the first Native American cabinet secretary in U.S. history.
**
Now, I'm running to be the next governor of New Mexico to help move our state toward a future where everyone can thrive.**

Dear Friend, The Freedom Caucus movement is expanding yet again!This coming Monday, lawmakers in Minnesota will officially launch the **Minnesota Freedom Caucus. **It will be the 15th state to join the State Freedom Caucus Network, proving that even in places long considered out of reach, conservative reform is organizing and growing.It was a busy week across the country. But this is the headline.
---
|
---
**MINNESOTA** As reported exclusively in _[_The Federalist_](http://give.statefreedomcaucus.org/ls/click?upn=u001.SSCAglCEkhp55PDWKhWTjo14OgpGP35sI5vBCzgz-2Fk4NJvBuXKkVli3lPXb-2B7xSK54jk-2F4CpuVytj-2Fydg1e-2BdPhDyO81S8-2Fj71BqaLGuk439iOSLmhMz8-2FJA6axevO9aUGVI1-2FAKe9-2BWFMSWaGV3JEtJSy4nOa-2FQEGkNz-2BVk7BEQpEywceTYrpnGlJhbbrqNuJPY_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVBZyx1SQGGYhOdwcjZYtHerqgzqLeYojz-2B7skjRhgwEWtwJahaQrqEkiNvleqaE-2BBt7llDrtRVLteoD3V0T-2FyxrfHpthpNs1QQkatcXiFcw3GwQjdCxAqXWkUw4lunzfLbd5yMJFOqRUQihlpPvXFZS9ld36nQMiaWaPbo6AmBtVeDEDwNitPzkwHhhpiy9FY2TykoYVF7DjsDMPrX7I-2F3koTc5KzoK0JNNrvEkTDk3x0WEeNbD531vu2DmoxCcGsY-3D), _the new **Minnesota Freedom Caucus** is**** launching this coming Monday, February 23. It will consist of four state senators and three state representatives, led by Chairman State Senator Eric Lucero.Most people don't know it, but by county, Minnesota is overwhelmingly Republican. It is the urban centers such as the Twin Cities and Duluth that narrowly tilt statewide elections. President Trump only lost the state 47 to 51 percent. The Minnesota House is split evenly at 67–67. Democrats hold the State Senate by a single vote, 34–33. This is not a deep blue state. It is a competitive state where disciplined conservatives can shape outcomes.As Chairman Lucero put it: “The path to restoring Minnesota to the once great state that it was is [by] returning to the Constitution and the founding principles of our republic. That’s why this [freedom caucus] is needed.” Minnesota has been plagued by fraud, waste, and insider politics. The Minnesota Freedom Caucus exists to expose that corruption and push for reforms - like election integrity - that reflect the values of the entire state, not the liberal voters inside the metropolitan core. **BOTTOM LINE:** I will be with the members of the new Minnesota Freedom Caucus, along with **House Freedom Caucus** Chairman Andy Harris at the state capitol on Monday at 10am ET for the official launch. Conservative states should not be governed by progressive insiders. Your MN Freedom Caucus lawmakers are organizing to change that.
---
[](http://give.statefreedomcaucus.org/ls/click?upn=u001.SSCAglCEkhp55PDWKhWTjo14OgpGP35sI5vBCzgz-2Fk4NJvBuXKkVli3lPXb-2B7xSK54jk-2F4CpuVytj-2Fydg1e-2BdPhDyO81S8-2Fj71BqaLGuk439iOSLmhMz8-2FJA6axevO9aUGVI1-2FAKe9-2BWFMSWaGV3JEtJSy4nOa-2FQEGkNz-2BVk7BEQpEywceTYrpnGlJhbbrqNb8mJ_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVBZyx1SQGGYhOdwcjZYtHerqgzqLeYojz-2B7skjRhgwEWtwJahaQrqEkiNvleqaE-2BBt7llDrtRVLteoD3V0T-2FyxrfHpthpNs1QQkatcXiFcw3GwQjdCxAqXWkUw4lunzfLZphss5JT38lvWqZigfgyjXbtewGUSebIf-2BoMkVfAvc3HhOej6uCoOJR01V4CiUnbFHMVoDlG8TNGY1fQZOEOVTM8185glkHwFe4JVyEe5-2Bo2FbQ0UAW5TdxbT4FYrauUA-3D)
---
|
---
**WEST VIRGINIA** Just days after launching the **West Virginia Freedom Caucus** , Chairman Chris Anders and I joined OAN’s [_The Matt Gaetz Show_](http://give.statefreedomcaucus.org/ls/click?upn=u001.SSCAglCEkhp55PDWKhWTjn-2BF3Ka3pedtTI7Xx70G-2Fk2xbEeECHtPQm-2FVRywjIJ-2FUbWSVvZ4r6m5EfVTtQG2Dow-3D-3DhnzV_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVBZyx1SQGGYhOdwcjZYtHerqgzqLeYojz-2B7skjRhgwEWtwJahaQrqEkiNvleqaE-2BBt7llDrtRVLteoD3V0T-2FyxrfHpthpNs1QQkatcXiFcw3GwQjdCxAqXWkUw4lunzfLZcqCHAYQtM8df3ISBB4XgOLCg6zWSuSe9KmbYGy2oTg9cUeXCjn3Bvv4UqICvNY9-2FThqED7lQwtyLuhNrO8uisXJyBZRNA6xVCFVkTb03VDDzz9Pi4Dap4iNThQaSbK6w-3D) to discuss the strategy behind building Freedom Caucuses across the country. The message was simple. The corruption in Washington is real. But so are the 50 swamps inside state capitols. We have cracked the code on how to reform state government. It requires organization, discipline, and a willingness to confront members of your own party when necessary. With President Trump winning West Virginia by nearly 70 percent, there is no excuse for half measures. A conservative governor and a disciplined legislative bloc can deliver real reform.**BOTTOM LINE:** The Freedom Caucus model is scaling because it works.
---
[](http://give.statefreedomcaucus.org/ls/click?upn=u001.SSCAglCEkhp55PDWKhWTjn-2BF3Ka3pedtTI7Xx70G-2Fk2xbEeECHtPQm-2FVRywjIJ-2FUbWSVvZ4r6m5EfVTtQG2Dow-3D-3DWyQe_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVBZyx1SQGGYhOdwcjZYtHerqgzqLeYojz-2B7skjRhgwEWtwJahaQrqEkiNvleqaE-2BBt7llDrtRVLteoD3V0T-2FyxrfHpthpNs1QQkatcXiFcw3GwQjdCxAqXWkUw4lunzfLblls4GFaEAs8PMX-2F-2FotTK8gokPLMz74W7dKz2HE0cSOcgEPZtBVyobGU3-2BSZ39BVNRkgvgVhsKy6jxgFiVecQDGYNYxAb5piHgiJ5Oea-2BKZxQG1jDTaPBsvIS4lxjYVBE-3D)
---
|
---
**MARYLAND** This week, **Maryland Freedom Caucus** member Delegate Mark Fisher highlighted stunning testimony in committee.A liberal witness admitted she reported students to Child Protective Services because they started a Turning Point USA chapter. The video went viral, surpassing hundreds of thousands of views and drawing national attention. Because of the MDFC exposing this, Assistant Attorney General Harmeet Dillon publicly stated she is looking into the matter.This is what State Freedom Caucuses do. They do not just vote correctly. They expose abuse of power and force accountability into the open. **BOTTOM LINE:** When intimidation is brought into the light, it loses its power.
---
[](http://give.statefreedomcaucus.org/ls/click?upn=u001.SSCAglCEkhp55PDWKhWTjhhDQHcKT6HxoU2bweg43wOYMIx6UvgRtGafLjSqk4ZaRrkXhH9GrMRoij33dpcA-2FTuc-2FUPlpEyX7xPNfOhjjqs-3DJRTN_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVBZyx1SQGGYhOdwcjZYtHerqgzqLeYojz-2B7skjRhgwEWtwJahaQrqEkiNvleqaE-2BBt7llDrtRVLteoD3V0T-2FyxrfHpthpNs1QQkatcXiFcw3GwQjdCxAqXWkUw4lunzfLYjsZfjImsR6jRxDbist2KcpNq1offIcGvwSuX3CaC0OiNPRw-2Ben47Z88TjunRJeIJxHN1ENyz6P9dQkCg-2BB3azvxma8yjBgfSSALREuzuzIW-2FAmXSeoUUzJbTgcyO79dU-3D)
---
|

| | | | | | Fellow Texan,
This week has been a whirlwind. I’ve been in Cypress, Allen, Beaumont, La Grange, and The Colony with Governor Abbott on a historic Get-Out-The-Vote tour.
As he introduced me at one rally, Governor Abbott said, “You got the best possible Comptroller you can have.” I’m honored to be serving at his request — and proud to share his vision to keep Texas the best place to live, work, and raise a family.
**Next week, we plan to be in another dozen cities across the state.**[**Please chip in $5 or $10 to fuel our effort as we travel the state, reach voters, and finish strong.**](https://kellyhancock.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dcaa9ba5f084f891ef21f7388&id=4e8ad66c0c&e=c7a460ad3d)

name: Gavin Newsom
subject: A massive fundraising disadvantage
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
This moment reminds me of Bobby Kennedy’s speech at the 1964 Democratic Convention.
**$5.**
That is the contribution I am asking you to make directly to Chris Pappas's campaign for United States Senate in New Hampshire.
If you're one of the people who already understands that control of the Senate is on-the-line in this race and are ready to make your first online contribution to his campaign today, please use this link:
**[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_cp_20260220_1?refcode=em20260220-1](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260220_1.FFkrb0&refcode=em20260220-1&t=1&akid=5208%2E582294%2EkZ_KfD)**
Otherwise, please let me explain why I am reaching out from the other side of the country to make this request.
Right now, Republicans have a massive fundraising advantage among the collection of party committees that could spend in New Hampshire.
And in many ways, this moment reminds me of Bobby Kennedy’s speech at the 1964 Democratic Convention.
After a 20 minute standing ovation, Bobby said that his brother would have never been able to accomplish any of what he had done without the support of you — the Democratic Party.
He said that when we're in it together, we can accomplish a great deal.
That was just as true 60 years ago as it is true today.
There is only one way out of this difficult moment where Republicans control the White House, the Senate and the House of Representatives ... and that is together.
Chris Pappas needs you. Our democracy needs you. Future generations need you. And it's why I am asking:
**[Can you please make a contribution directly to Chris Pappas's campaign for U.S. Senate in New Hampshire? We can effectively end Trump's presidency if we can take back Congress this November.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260220_1.FFkrb0&refcode=em20260220-1&t=2&akid=5208%2E582294%2EkZ_KfD)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260220_1.FFkrb0&amount=5&refcode=em20260220-1&t=21&akid=5208%2E582294%2EkZ_KfD)**
Thank you for your support during the Proposition 50 fight in California, and thank you for supporting Chris today.
Gavin Newsom
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260220_1.FFkrb0&refcode=em20260220-1&t=22&akid=5208%2E582294%2EkZ_KfD)
**New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_cp_footer?refcode=em20260220-1&t=23&refcode2=5208_582294_kZ_KfD&akid=5208%2E582294%2EkZ_KfD)**
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a critical way we communicate with grassroots supporters like you. However, if you would like to change your subscription preferences, here are some options:
* [Receive Fewer Emails](https://act.chrispappas.org/signup/cps_receive_fewer_emails/?t=24&akid=5208%2E582294%2EkZ_KfD)
* [Update Your Information](https://act.chrispappas.org/signup/cps_update_your_information/?t=25&akid=5208%2E582294%2EkZ_KfD)
* [Unsubscribe](https://act.chrispappas.org/unsubscribe/cps_unsubscribe/?t=26&akid=5208%2E582294%2EkZ_KfD)

Email us: [teampappas@chrispappas.org](mailto:teampappas@chrispappas.org)

# [Don't Let Trump Get Us Into a Disastrous War with Iran](https://default.salsalabs.org/T005994da-80a2-4259-9c17-d5919d78acc4/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

[**Sign no****w, and demand that Congress stop him. **](https://default.salsalabs.org/T496931a3-6b8a-4767-9e82-68285dec7461/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Trump seems hellbent on going to war, but his reasons seem to shift by the day. And he doesn't appear to have any idea what he's about to get us into. Iran has nearly 100 million people, with just under a million in its active-duty military and reserves. **And it may already have nuclear weapons.** It also has the ability to close off the Strait of Hormuz, stopping a enormous amount of the world's oil exports, and driving oil prices to unprecedented levels. **This is not a cake walk, it is an extremely dangerous undertaking, and we better have one hell of a good reason before we do it.** Congress has the power to stop him, and it must use that power now. [**Tell Congress: "Don't let Trump get us into a disastrous war with Iran.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf4f3ab09-277c-4522-b821-b9fd0de6b2c2/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

[This is a longer email, but I respectfully ask you to read it start to finish.](https://links.iterable.com/s/c/ESLuOatj8zq3A0us1XmGHF28mQKs2Hv_5DdlQg4qtlqRrfcnc8_1AJwcgN3NVlcKEow6292iVSZlTYP_4xre9-DEYkJS82ijUI9JSS44-uei_eqC9H_jdR0pOBukzR-BZs4TKMdFznHiMeAy_JuYZxhRXOdK_phevAfWxB9DjvT62mgbJcbl-d9nDEoKvQQT7oZVq43LamtTDBlukx135yzDlVgISNJtcrEd9gkzbixyt7DcOz62L2XfTG1ijEUIwQQxNGLd5H3lLxVTPxLOUFKA8RsIBQJfD2ewdThkHqArHYwTTlV1xz7h0Uk5zo6e_YGOFk2LWLIxzW1S_kf_eneixb3y9ynqc8ORRNSABAhPIetjvEh0cYaPRqTSNNC1LVuE2cP_0fWriM4VtKx8Q1MvUNFxqRGY4l804qBGTrZ1RzTquunZIUULSq3cKxyYlvF_fUoYmxd13qFhz36bONyVyWaC-gPfzPxYKhFlZ4AgKXGNBPiV-uRjaJF7SHpLgtYv55Ac1hkvx_akdHg_Vg021FGtkApjIVtnltBlSVoygIrg0dlQrjj02duZfQmBnGDHSAnynICmcN2ZTHgipJnKU_kYx3Us5kWg0rc3uItAEiZWJa4lwdyHVcywuchishbJn2SZtx_YToPcqRttLNtobiwgxRfHiJ9hOJd3FLyutYz6Yc-X3oTfcu4DuT2lUHUd7GpiaKs_s9FwsYy1I994T3P29LMRj7jm9-DLMqstrnzvviTXuHe-MLDlbQ8VM3eD8JMgtQnR2V2YukGrFc27VZO0_5btRjckkocWJ2dK2iA4lqvlEtNTNpfcaO-xnMluBOfx8gRkkYI/0Fj7pqfjMwn0VXE68fL_pdk1iOapqazh/18)
It wasn't easy telling the world I grew up dirt poor, I was raised by my Mamaw while my mother struggled with addiction.
It wasn't exactly the prep school/trust fund/summer-in-the-Hamptons upbringing that is commonplace in DC.
But I felt God called me to tell my story. Warts and all. I felt led to speak out because I believe millions of Americans share stories like mine. Stories of jobs being outsourced to China, addiction ravaging communities and killing our neighbors, and heeding the call of duty after the Towers fell on 9/11.
As your Vice President, I now stand in the breach for the left-behind, forgotten men and women who built this country, but were abandoned by the political class in DC.

Friends,
A few weeks ago, we wrapped our National Virtual Boot Camp —an intensive training built for candidates already on the ballot. In just days, these women sharpened their message, strengthened their fundraising, and built the field and digital strategies they need to win—right now.
At the same time, our National Virtual Signature Program is preparing what comes next. This six-month training equips Democratic women and non-binary leaders—especially in states without an Emerge affiliate—with the skills, confidence, and network to run in the next 2–3 cycles.
And on the ground, we’re training new cohorts in South Carolina, Georgia, Virginia, and Washington—building local power, mentorship, and lasting political infrastructure in communities across the country.
This is how we change the face of politics.
Emerge is building a pipeline of leaders who are ready to step up, run for office, and win. We provide the tools, training, and support they need at every stage - whether they are running in 2026 or beyond.
But none of this happens without you.
Will you invest in the next generation of leaders today? Your support ensures more women have the resources—and the network—to run and win.

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Democracy Docket: Texas governor threatens state takeover of Houston elections [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=022026_1&amount=25]
Opponents of voting rights are after Houston again, Team.
Texas Gov. Greg Abbott recently threatened Harris County (which contains Houston) with a state takeover of its elections. This is just the latest step in an ongoing escalation of long-simmering threats to gain control of voting in the fourth-largest city in the United States.
Why? Because a GOP state lawmaker alleged that 100 voters were unlawfully registered using post office box addresses instead of street addresses. 100 potentially inaccurate registrations out of more than 2.5 million registered voters and a county population of 4.7 million people -- 0.04% of registrations. Imagine taking over a whole county's elections process over four-hundredths of a percentage point?
The vote suppressors have targeted Houston for years. They started after widespread use of mail-in ballots drove high voter participation during the pandemic, attacking how the county collected ballots. Then Gov. Abbott signed two suppressive bills into law that only affected Harris County and no others in the state. Now he's threatening a full partisan takeover of Houston's voting process in order to restrict ballot access in the county where his party does the worst in elections.
Opponents of voting rights in Texas have gone too far, Team, and we need to fight back. Chip in with $15, $20, $35 or whatever you can right now to stop suppression like this and defend our fundamental right to vote in Houston and across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=022026_1&amount=35]

Need a refresher? In 2023, Texas's state legislature passed SB-1993, which empowers a partisan state official to override the vote in counties with populations higher than 2.7 million if they run low on paper ballots for more than an hour anytime on election day. Harris County -- home to Houston and those 4.7 million people -- was the only Texas county with a population that big and potentially subject to partisan takeover.
Opponents of voting rights consistently attack our cities and the voters who live in and around them. It's part of their explicit strategy as their ability to tip the scales in elections has eroded and barriers to voting have been broken down. One of the 2023 laws was even written by an anti-voting Houston-area state senator in order to prop up his own party and protect their power in a state that's continually sliding away from MAGA.
Voter suppression anywhere hurts us everywhere, Team. Fuel our efforts to fight back with $35 or whatever you can today to make sure our votes count and everyone is heard in our elections >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=022026_1&amount=35]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

subject: Keeping hope alive - a final salute to a giant of democracy
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Local Democracy Project
body:
| | |
At Local Democracy Project, we bow our heads in deep gratitude for the life of Rev. Jesse L. Jackson. He was more than a leader; he was a moral compass who recalibrated the very soul of our democracy, reminding us that the pursuit of justice is a sacred, endless journey. Jesse Jackson was the ultimate architect of the possible. He began in the trenches of the local South, turning lunch counters into classrooms of courage. He showed us that democracy begins on the sidewalk in the way we treat our neighbors and the way we demand dignity for the worker. He taught us that the ballot is not merely a piece of paper, but a prayer for a better world - a tool to lift the marginalized from the shadows and into the sunlight of opportunity. We are indebted to his vision of the Rainbow Coalition, a practical dream that saw beauty in our diversity and strength in our common ground. He challenged us to, to "keep hope alive" not as a passive sentiment, but as a militant, joyous commitment to one another. Rev. Jackson’s voice was the drumbeat of a movement, and his legacy is the path we now walk. He showed us that when we stand together, the "unmovable" mountains of inequality must finally give way. Today, we honor him by continuing the work he pioneered: protecting the ballot, empowering the neighborhood, rebuilding democracy from the ground up, and always, always keeping hope alive.

name: Pete Barlow for Congress
subject: What's love got to do with it?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pete Barlow For Congress
body:
Reflections on resistance, politics, and real change

| |
---
| | **What’s love got to do with it?** Politics and love are not words commonly used together. The contest for political ascendancy can be vicious as candidates vie for votes and parties seek dominance. I am committed to changing that. **My campaign is built on listening and talking with****all****my neighbors.** Replacing a Republican who won’t meet with non-Republican constituents with a Democrat who does the same will not build a healthy democracy. It is time to reclaim respectful engagement, which is a form of love, in our public life. **This week brought us several reminders that loving our neighbors is the key to real change.** On Wednesday, the **first day of Ramadan** and **Ash Wednesday** , two major world religions started seasons of fasting, prayer, and repentance. Our Muslim and Christian neighbors will be spending the next 30 to 40 days reflecting on what it means to be faithful. Both religions reach the same answer:**love your neighbor, care for the poor, welcome the stranger** , and show your faith in how you treat others.
