| | Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud.

He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus.

He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness.

And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible.

I saw it up close -- _Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. _

But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything.

_**He started observing the Sabbath. **_

Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance.

_But as an act of obedience. _

As a way of saying, **_" God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." _**

Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped.

He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield.

No email. No media. No work.

He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children.

It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much.

But over time, it changed him.

And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned...

clean_body: It wasn’t about politics... Peter, Charlie’s final book is available with a gift of any amount to Turning Point USA. | | | | | Peter, | | Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud. He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus. He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness. And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible. I saw it up close -- Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything. He started observing the Sabbath. Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance. But as an act of obedience. As a way of saying, " God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped. He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield. No email. No media. No work. He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children. It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much. But over time, it changed him. And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned... This was Charlie's final message. His final act of trust. A book not about politics... but about peace. It 's called: Stop, in the Name of God. Peter, like I mentioned, this isn't a political book. It's not a culture war manifesto. It's a call to stop. To rest. To breathe. To return to God. Because Charlie believed America hadn 't just forgotten truth... It had forgotten trust. Trust that the world keeps spinning when you step away. Trust that God is in control. Trust that rest is not weakness -- it's worship. In Stop, in the Name of God, you'll discover: 🔥 How Charlie reclaimed the Sabbath in a world built on burnout 🔥 What sacred rest gave back to him -- as a father, husband, and believer 🔥 Why he believed this message could spark revival in a restless generation Charlie wrote this book because he knew what it meant to nearly lose his peace -- and what it felt like to find it again. That's the heartbeat of his final message. Charlie Kirk didn't waste his time on earth. He left behind a family. He left behind a movement. And he left behind this truth... For anyone ready to step off the treadmill... and walk back toward what's eternal. Peter, thank you -- in advance -- for helping reach the next generation with truth, faith, and moral courage. These are the very things Charlie gave his life for. May the message he left behind lead you -- just as it led him -- to a deeper trust in God... A stronger love for your family... And a renewed peace in your own soul. For Charlie, Justin Streiff Chief Operating Officer Turning Point USA P.S.Stop, in the Name of God is Charlie Kirk's final message -- written in obedience, shaped by Scripture, and grounded in trust in the Lord. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044 | This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com

Friends,
It’s been one year since the Senate voted to confirm Kash Patel as Director of the FBI. After he was sworn in, I wrote a letter to him about the severity of the gun violence crisis in America.
I asked if he would meet with me and a small group of gun violence survivors, just like a FEMA administrator would meet with victims of hurricanes or the Secretary of Defense would meet with the families of fallen troops.
I haven’t heard back.

# **Megyn Kelly calls for CNN 's Abby Phillip to be fired over bias, attacks on Trump**
SiriusXM host Megyn Kelly criticized CNN's Abby Phillip on Thursday, **[calling for her to be fired](https://substack.com/redirect/9c555310-a454-45c5-bb5c-89a1c5ef35f7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after Phillip deflected from Rep. * **Why it matters:** Kelly also condemned Phillip for enabling left-wing podcaster Jennifer Welch to call White House deputy chief of staff Stephen Miller a "Nazi Jew" during an October podcast appearance without pushback. **PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
| | Happy Friday,
Have you been following our videos on social media? We've been diving deeper into topics you, our readers, have been loving. Make sure you check us out, follow along, and let us know your thoughts in the comments! _[Facebook](https://link.email.joinrmv.) | [Instagram](https://link.email.joinrmv.) | [X](https://link.email.joinrmv.) | [TikTok](https://link.email.joinrmv.) | [Threads](https://link.email.joinrmv.) | [TruthSocial](https://link.email.joinrmv.) | [LinkedIn](https://link.email.joinrmv.)_
Listen to today's Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.joinrmv.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.joinrmv.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.joinrmv.). Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏛️ **Under the Golden Dome...** Democrats are advancing contentious measures critics say expand state authority at the expense of local control and parental rights. Lawmakers are weighing a bill to [fully decriminalize prostitution statewide](https://link.email.joinrmv.) and [bar cities from banning it](https://link.email.joinrmv.), while Medicaid costs continue to [drive higher overall spending despite prior cuts](https://link.email.joinrmv.). At the same time, proposals involving red-flag laws, immunization policy, and gender-related custody disputes are [raising concerns among parents](https://link.email.joinrmv.) and faith groups about constitutional protections.
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** The Colorado Board of Health voted to [ease strict delayed birth certificate rules](https://link.email.joinrmv.), replacing the long-standing “before age 10” document requirement with a more flexible standard aimed at helping residents secure proof of birth. In HD-59, [former Rep. J. Paul Brown is endorsing Naomi Riess](https://link.email.joinrmv.) as a conservative, agriculture-focused candidate to counter what he calls overreach from Denver. Meanwhile, a ballot push could temporarily suspend the independent redistricting commission to [redraw congressional maps](https://link.email.joinrmv.), as a new report details how abortion advocacy group Cobalt has [defeated 51 restriction bills while expanding revenue](https://link.email.joinrmv.) and benefiting from broader public funding.
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** The Transportation Department has ordered more than 550 commercial driving schools to [close over safety failures](https://link.email.joinrmv.), citing unqualified instructors and inadequate testing. Separately, a new report [raises concerns about mail ballots](https://link.email.joinrmv.) routed across state lines and postmark inconsistencies, highlighting the nearly 550,000 ballots rejected nationwide in 2022.
This is your Mountain Minute for Friday, February 20, 2026.
– Team RMV

**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[From 51 defeated bills to $8M in revenue: How Cobalt reshaped Colorado abortion policy](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
A Colorado abortion advocacy organization is celebrating a decade of legislative defeats—51 abortion-restriction bills blocked since 2010—while reporting record spending and a surge in out-of-state demand.
On its website, Cobalt says it has “testified against and helped defeat 51 anti-abortion bills at the Colorado General Assembly since 2010.”
A February data report shows more than $2.4 million spent in 2025 on abortion procedures and practical support, including travel and lodging.
Those numbers, drawn from Cobalt’s own reports and IRS filings, reflect more than annual fundraising success. They trace a broader shift in Colorado’s policy landscape. For more than a decade, restriction bills repeatedly died in committee.

**[Colorado Ballot Push Aims To Redraw Maps And Diminish GOP Representation](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** [CPR](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **Ballot measure would sideline Colorado’s independent redistricting commission:** A newly formed group is pushing a 2026 ballot initiative to temporarily suspend or weaken the voter-approved commission so lawmakers can redraw congressional maps for 2028 and 2030.
* **Proposed maps could shift delegation to a 7–1 Democratic advantage:** Supporters frame the effort as a response to redistricting moves in other states, while critics call it a partisan attempt to override the will of voters who enshrined the commission in the state constitution.
* **Republicans warn of partisan gerrymandering and rule-changing:** GOP leaders argue suspending the commission for two election cycles undermines the nonpartisan process Colorado voters overwhelmingly approved to prevent political map manipulation.

* **Bill would fully decriminalize prostitution statewide:** The proposal, introduced by four Democratic lawmakers, would remove criminal penalties for adults who buy or sell consensual commercial sex and prohibit local governments from banning it.
* **Supporters argue decriminalization improves safety and protections:** Advocates say the measure would reduce violence, curb trafficking, and provide labor and housing protections by allowing individuals to operate without fear of arrest.
* **Opponents warn of moral and social consequences:** Critics, including Republican lawmakers and anti-trafficking advocates, argue the bill degrades women, could increase sex tourism, and ignores the goal many women have of leaving prostitution altogether.

## My takeaways from this week's White House event...
On Wednesday I was honored to join in the White House celebration of Black History month
It was a great event -- hosted by a great administration.
But even more than being a great event, it highlighted some of this administration's recent achievements.
Of course, these are the type of things you'll never hear the legacy media discuss.
As the White House's [Rapid Reponse 47](https://substack.com/redirect/4898e206-6fa8-49ac-a39e-84f3cacbb962?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) X account put it:
"Since descending the golden escalator, President Trump has been relentlessly smeared as a 'racist' by the Radical Left who can't tolerate a President who sees only one people, one family, and one glorious nation under God."
It's true.
They can't stand to admit when he does something good, even when it's something completely uncontroversial that benefits Americans.
Those wins were on display at this week's event, and it made me optimistic about what the rest of the year--and the rest of President Trump's term--holds.
Let's break it down...

Maine Gov. Janet Mills (D) had a confusing Friday.
First she told the Bangor newspaper that she planned to boycott President Donald Trump's meeting of governors in Washington, D.C.
It was a "you go girl" moment for the #RESISTANCE that the newspaper splashed over their front page.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3bb9b6b2-a548-4442-8b90-0786e35d108f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
A few hours later Gov. Mills was photographed sitting meekly at the event she'd claimed she was boycotting.

So what's going on? Other than, of course, Mills ragtime operation clearly headed for defeat in the Democratic U.S. Senate primary against Graham Platner.

body:
A Pentagon contractor. A DOJ official. A State Farm VP. All caught on hidden camera. All lawyered up. I need your help to fight back.
[View in Web Browser](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e8395187/VaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvellVRXc4cmFodw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjAyMjA/LbmNsUW9MU1dNWA/qP2hpZHM9bmM1cVBTWllrdHFlOExscw/gaZiYUQ/s8mbd85736d)

| | | | | [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
| Dear Friend,
Right now, on my desk, there are three active lawsuits. Not because I broke the law. Not because I lied. **Because I pointed a camera at the wrong people — and they talked.** A former FBI agent who was working as a Pentagon contractor [**told our undercover journalist**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) he was coordinating with retired generals to "explore what we can do" to "protect people from Trump." He got fired from Booz Allen the day we published. Now he's suing me. A DOJ official sat across from our reporter on what he thought was a date — and admitted on camera that the government would redact Republican names from the Epstein files while leaving Democrats exposed. The DOJ scrambled to do damage control within hours. Now they want me silenced. A State Farm vice president bragged about how the company orchestrates rate hikes and mocked wildfire victims — on hidden camera. He was terminated immediately. Now he's filed criminal eavesdropping charges against my reporter in Cook County, Illinois. Let me be direct with you: **_They don't sue you when you're wrong. They sue you when you're right and they can't make the tape go away._** I just released a short video that shows the full scope of what we're up against — and why we keep going. [**Watch it here:**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) **[****](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**[****](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) In that video, you'll hear things that would stop most people cold. Board members at my former organization — the one I built from nothing — conspiring to destroy me. Lawyers I personally hired admitting on tape they wanted to assault me. Deposition testimony revealing that the very board members who fired me were co-investing in pharmaceutical companies that "could be sold to big Pharma, like Pfizer" — while we were actively investigating Pfizer. And still, through all of that, we rebuilt. O'Keefe Media Group launched the day I walked out the door. And in two years, we have done more damage to the establishment than they ever thought possible. **That's why the lawsuits keep coming.** Here's what you need to understand: every one of these legal attacks is designed to do one thing — make the cost of truth so high that we stop pursuing it. That's the playbook. That's always been the playbook. Bury the journalist in legal fees until the cameras go dark. **I will never let that happen.** But I cannot do this alone. Liberty Guard has established a legal defense fund specifically to keep us in the fight. Every dollar goes directly toward courtroom defense, investigative operations, and protecting the reporters who risk everything to bring you the truth. **Here's what your contribution makes possible:** **[**$25**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** — Helps cover court filing costs and legal document preparation **[**$50**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** — Funds one hour of legal research for our active cases **[**$100**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** — Keeps an undercover investigation running for one additional day **[**$250**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** — Covers a portion of deposition preparation against one of our three active lawsuits **[**$500**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** — Directly funds First Amendment defense motions being filed right now **[**$1,000+**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** — Ensures our anti-SLAPP filing in D.C. — a case that could set nationwide precedent for undercover journalism — gets the resources it needs to win **[****](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** | | [DONATE NOW — STAND WITH JAMES](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
The people we've exposed had power, access, and the protection of massive institutions. What they didn't have was the truth on their side.
**We do.**
And with your help, no amount of legal intimidation will silence us.
_My price is my life — not money, not comfort._
[**Stand with me.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
In the fight,
James O'Keefe
Founder and CEO
O'Keefe Media Group

**P.S.** The attorney behind the Pentagon contractor's lawsuit has publicly stated he is recruiting additional plaintiffs and planning more lawsuits against our organization. This is a coordinated legal campaign to shut down undercover journalism in America. [**Your donation today doesn't just defend me — it defends the right of every citizen journalist to hold the powerful accountable.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)

These matters demand seriousness, care, and integrity, not anonymous attacks timed for political advantage. Republican delegates deserve better than misinformation built on the suffering of victims.
I have always been open and transparent about my work as a prosecutor. It is disappointing that anonymous individuals have chosen to circulate misleading claims rather than raise concerns directly or address them in a public, accountable forum.
As Republican delegates prepare for county and state conventions, you deserve facts, not distortions.
Several assertions in the anonymous email now circulating are demonstrably false.
Most notably, the [ESPN article](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0016ZrmKtDdpddCBr9imy3EH3HHwERAxwB20-_QUse72g3YxqjECYI04MwK-e0KSDXHQY5ygelvvfLTLAs9aRytzEWxazS-rYiif3jykkw43PHEQzlJ_e1ZxNl455N6l5YXp-YMF1c3kx7qCUGIRwhlsI_UVUaH7c9qrcPbTpH5_lZv7GAiq2lCZoajlf0vDVFQyceT6xlf7WRv7yjFqoSqyr3PfVehDuF_xS93b7wU66OB-U2j8gCoRnOhWMp0vGl4yfYRkminZ1rOHohbE2BvTD4rI8LfrNe6G0EfmHVCskw=&c=hitEQv87Jd5EIn_kUtSpzCSH0RYEAm9aWv9FaCFn8T0r17tgpgGtcg==&ch=T8KTEX4SFvsJ5Rh1sVurkRUJ9vk_vZy0AJ5nK9-La8-wufPWhcHFsw==) cited does not mention me, nor does it quote me praising Attorney General Dana Nessel. That claim is simply untrue. Misrepresenting published reporting to create a narrative is not advocacy; it is misinformation.
I also want to be clear about my role in the Geddert matter. I do not speculate publicly about charging decisions made more than a decade ago without reviewing the complete file, and responsible prosecutors should not.
When allegations resurfaced in 2018, my office had the case for approximately three months. Some of the victims were also victims in the Larry Nassar case, and the Attorney General's Office had already built established relationships and trust with them. The attorneys involved at the Attorney General's Office were the same attorneys who handled the Nassar prosecution during Attorney General Bill Schuette's administration.
For those reasons, I made the decision to allow the Attorney General's Office to handle the case. This was done to protect victims, avoid unnecessary duplication, and ensure continuity by attorneys already familiar with the individuals involved.
It is also important to understand that county prosecutor offices do not conduct independent investigations. We evaluate cases based on evidence gathered by law enforcement. The Attorney General's Office, by contrast, has investigators in-house and broader resources, which further supported the decision to defer.
Once the Attorney General's Office assumed responsibility, all investigative and charging decisions were theirs. After charges were announced in 2021, John Geddert died by suicide before the case could be resolved in court. There was never a trial and never a legal determination of guilt or innocence.
Questions have also been raised about a 2013 complaint involving John Geddert. At that time, my office reviewed the police report and concluded there was sufficient evidence to support a charge related to inappropriate physical conduct. The matter was resolved through a lawful disposition that included counseling and a written apology to the gymnast. There were no additional complainants or corroborating evidence available at that time. Prosecutors must make decisions based on the evidence before them, not on information that emerges years later.
Cases involving historical abuse allegations demand experienced prosecutors who understand evidentiary standards, ethical obligations, and the limits of the law. Oversimplifying these cases or misrepresenting the public record does not help victims and reflects a lack of understanding of how prosecution actually works.
Finally, I believe Republican voters deserve open discussion and accountability. Anonymous attacks released on the eve of conventions, while refusing to raise these claims publicly or participate in debates, are not how serious candidates conduct themselves. I have been willing to address my record directly and will continue to do so.
I stand by my work, my judgment, and my commitment to the rule of law.
Sincerely,
Doug Lloyd Eaton County Prosecuting Attorney Candidate for Michigan Attorney General

name: Tim Walz
subject: We can’t let them win
body:
Peter,
I wanted to emphasize just how serious of a moment we are in.
Donald Trump’s federal agents are going door to door in Minnesota looking for folks based on their accent or color of their skin. Kids are afraid to go to school, small businesses are hurting, another life has been lost, and the people responsible have yet to be held accountable. Instead, Donald Trump’s DOJ is investigating me.
Why? Because my focus has always been protecting the people of Minnesota.
They’re trying to scare me and our state — but Minnesota will not be intimidated into silence and neither will I. This legal battle will be expensive, that’s why they’re doing this. They want me to back down and surrender, but I won’t.
I need your help in this fight. If you’re able, please split a donation between our Legal Defense fund and Outrage then Action PAC and make sure we can continue to stand up to Donald Trump and his DOJ? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp_2026_dga?refcode=partner_ms_tw_em_022026_realtexaspac]
I'm grateful,
Tim Walz

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

body:
#

🌞 To all of Ruben Gallego’s supporters 🌵
We are asking you, humbly: Don’t click away from this email.
The truth is, the vast majority of people who read this won’t do that; they’ll look the other way. We’re hoping you’re different.

As a matter of fact, _we need you to be different._
As you read this, Ruben is speaking out against Trump and Republicans in Congress as they try to destroy our democracy. He’s traveling the country to reach people we need to pull to our side. He’s doing interviews and media daily to reach even more people nationwide.

The way we retake the momentum from Trump right now is you.
If everyone reading this donated just $5, we would raise enough to run our operations for months. We would break records. We’d even have enough to support other candidates who are in tough campaigns over the next two years.

We’ve been saying for over a year that Americans are paying the price for Trump’s pointless global tariffs, and now the Supreme Court has had their say:
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=50]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25]
Over the past year, 90% of the economic burden of Trump’s tariffs fell on U.S. companies and consumers. Not foreign countries. Not overseas manufacturers. Us!
And the highest court in the country has confirmed that they’re not just bad policy — they’re also an abuse of presidential power and an overreach of the executive branch.
You know things are bad when even THIS Supreme Court says Trump has gone too far...
Trump has claimed that foreign governments are “paying” for his tariffs. But that’s literally not how tariffs work. Tariffs are just taxes on goods that we import from other countries — things like electronics, coffee, cars, furniture, and wine.
These taxes raise costs on the goods we buy, squeeze small businesses, and drive up prices for families who are already struggling to afford housing, child care, health care, and groceries.
And instead of targeting bad actors, Trump slapped pointless tariffs on some of our closest allies — including Canada — making life more expensive for Americans for NO GOOD REASON.
This SCOTUS ruling is a win for the American people, plain and simple (a sentence I never thought I’d say under this Supreme Court...). But we know that with the Trump administration, ideology and ego will continue to replace real economic policy — until we replace our leadership.
The only way to stop these GOP economic failures, bring down costs for Americans, and create more jobs for the long-term is to change who’s in power.
That means electing more Democrats this November. If you can, please contribute today so we can support strong Democrats across the country who will fight back against Trump’s disastrous economic policies. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25]

Peter, Elon Musk sparked a __**HUGE**__ conversation on Joe Rogan about immigration policy, government systems, and the real threats to voting...

He highlighted concerns that **open borders allow non-citizens to flood in and affect our democracy, including potentially influencing votes.**

Musk explained: **_“That’s why they want open borders... That’s why some leaders changed their views on borders. That’s the reason—to bring in more people who could affect our systems.”_**

That's why Congress passed the SAVE Act (Safeguard American Voter Eligibility Act) in the House — a game-changing bill to require documentary proof of U.S. citizenship before anyone can register to vote.

_But the Senate is stalling_ — _**and we can't let that happen.**_

With millions at stake, we need massive pressure **NOW** to force a vote and _**get the SAVE Act to the President's desk.**_

Backed and authored by **House Freedom Caucus member Rep. Chip Roy** , the SAVE Act fights back against the very threats Elon Musk exposed on Rogan—requiring ironclad citizenship proof to protect your vote.

## Let’s Win Wisconsin’s 5th Together!
---
The momentum is real — and it’s growing fast.
Every week I’m meeting more people across Wisconsin’s 5th Congressional District who are ready for new leadership and ready to fight for our democracy. I’m incredibly grateful for the strong support and encouragement coming from our district organizations and county Democratic parties. This campaign is powered by people — and you are proving that grassroots energy can compete with big money politics.
|
---
On **February 8th** , I had the privilege of joining the **Dousman Area Dems luncheon**. The room was full of engaged voters asking tough questions, sharing concerns, and offering ideas about where we go from here. These conversations matter. They remind me that voters want someone who listens, shows up, and fights for them — not another politician who disappears after Election Day.
|
---
Just a few days later, on **February 14th** , I delivered a campaign address at the **Francesca Hong event in West Bend**. The energy was incredible — people ready to organize, volunteer, and build a movement strong enough to win in 2026. That spirit is exactly what we need as we head into the critical months ahead.
Now we need to step on the gas.
I’m actively scheduling speaking events across the district — with **unions, church groups, civic organizations, community groups, and local gatherings**. If you want me to come speak with your group, or if you can help connect us with organizers, we need your help right now. We’re also looking for volunteers to help fill the calendar and coordinate events. The more places we show up, the more voters we reach — and that’s how we win.
There are only **172 days** until the August 11th primary — and just **256 days** until the general election. The time to ramp up is now. We must organize harder, talk to more voters, and build the kind of campaign that can defeat Scott Fitzgerald and bring real representation back to Wisconsin’s 5th District.This campaign isn’t about one person — it’s about all of us. Thank you for being part of it. Let’s keep pushing forward.
In solidarity,Andy

ICE is expanding its unwanted presence in my district. The agency is planning to use a new office in Southfield to intensify their operations against our communities, and a new warehouse jail in Romulus to cage hundreds of our neighbors in unsafe conditions.
I’m joining my neighbors and local elected officials to fight back. **We must use every tool at our disposal to keep ICE out of our neighborhoods, and that includes pushing local and state officials to stop cooperating with ICE.**
In my district, a police department recently called ICE as part of conducting a traffic stop so agents could kidnap one of our neighbors. I stood with my community, working with advocates and state legislators to demand an end to this practice of coordinating with ICE.

This had a ripple effect: Other local cities and communities came out with statements soon after, declaring that they won’t cooperate with ICE.
These examples illustrate how many ICE-related decisions are happening at the local and state levels—and how much power we have when we push local and state leaders to protect our communities.

This work is urgent, especially as immigration agencies plan to rapidly expand detention centers in our communities around the country, and as we hear more horrors about them torturing people in detention.
There are many ways to plug in. At the bottom of this email you can find links to sample policies, demands to make of officials, and maps you can use to find your county or state’s policies about immigration enforcement. Here’s a quick overview:
**School boards and school districts** can develop school sanctuary policies and plans for what to do if ICE invades the school. They can also stop partnering with Flock (which works with ICE) on security cameras, which record license plate numbers that are fed into a national database used by law enforcement to help deport our immigrant neighbors.
**City leaders** can limit local law enforcement’s cooperation with ICE, attempt to block ICE from using local land or buildings, make sure local tax dollars don’t go to corporations that work with ICE, and adopt policies that restrict ICE on city or county property.
**Sheriffs** are elected, and since they run local jails, they can end bed rental programs that allow ICE to use space in jails, refuse to facilitate transfers of people to immigration detention, prohibit staff from asking people about their place of birth or citizenship status, block ICE from accessing the jail, and refuse to notify or share information with ICE about people in their facilities.
**State officials** can:
* pass or implement stronger sanctuary policies
* create statewide legal defense funds for immigrants
* ban and close detention centers
* pass policies to protect immigrants’ civil and constitutional rights
* refuse to sign contracts (or end contracts that are currently in place) with private prison companies that run immigration detention centers
* prohibit the state police from aiding ICE officers
* limit state and local information sharing with ICE
* work with their state’s Attorney General to monitor and sue ICE
* use state funds to help organizations running “Know Your Rights” campaigns and food banks and bail support
* stop human trafficking by ending transfers from state jails and prisons to ICE
* strengthen tenant protections including imposing eviction moratoriums during ICE operations

Thank you. I promise to continue fighting back in Congress, including supporting legislation like the Melt ICE Act and introducing amendments to end immigration detention.
We recently held another Know Your Rights training with the National Lawyers Guild Detroit & Michigan Chapter, about how people can enforce their constitutional rights during encounters with ICE and other law enforcement.
I will keep running these trainings, connecting immigrants with legal services, and pushing for a just and humane immigration system—with paths to citizenship for immigrants and asylum-seekers.
As a former immigration attorney I know that immigration legal proceedings fall under civil law, not criminal law. Migration is not a crime, and we must push back against the criminalization and dehumanization of immigrants.
In solidarity,
Rashida

[sign on] To: dpwillis67@gmail.com Friend, ICE is expanding its unwanted presence in my district. The agency is planning to use a new office in Southfield to intensify their operations against our communities, and a new warehouse jail in Romulus to cage hundreds of our neighbors in unsafe conditions. I’m joining my neighbors and local elected officials to fight back. We must use every tool at our disposal to keep ICE out of our neighborhoods, and that includes pushing local and state officials to stop cooperating with ICE. In my district, a police department recently called ICE as part of conducting a traffic stop so agents could kidnap one of our neighbors. I stood with my community, working with advocates and state legislators to demand an end to this practice of coordinating with ICE. Our voices were heard! The city’s police and mayor announced that they’re updating their protocols, and for now they will not contact federal immigration authorities during routine police activity. This had a ripple effect: Other local cities and communities came out with statements soon after, declaring that they won’t cooperate with ICE. These examples illustrate how many ICE-related decisions are happening at the local and state levels—and how much power we have when we push local and state leaders to protect our communities. This work is urgent, especially as immigration agencies plan to rapidly expand detention centers in our communities around the country, and as we hear more horrors about them torturing people in detention. There are many ways to plug in. At the bottom of this email you can find links to sample policies, demands to make of officials, and maps you can use to find your county or state’s policies about immigration enforcement. Here’s a quick overview: School boards and school districts can develop school sanctuary policies and plans for what to do if ICE invades the school. They can also stop partnering with Flock (which works with ICE) on security cameras, which record license plate numbers that are fed into a national database used by law enforcement to help deport our immigrant neighbors. City leaders can limit local law enforcement’s cooperation with ICE, attempt to block ICE from using local land or buildings, make sure local tax dollars don’t go to corporations that work with ICE, and adopt policies that restrict ICE on city or county property. Sheriffs are elected, and since they run local jails, they can end bed rental programs that allow ICE to use space in jails, refuse to facilitate transfers of people to immigration detention, prohibit staff from asking people about their place of birth or citizenship status, block ICE from accessing the jail, and refuse to notify or share information with ICE about people in their facilities. State officials can: pass or implement stronger sanctuary policies create statewide legal defense funds for immigrants ban and close detention centers pass policies to protect immigrants’ civil and constitutional rights refuse to sign contracts (or end contracts that are currently in place) with private prison companies that run immigration detention centers prohibit the state police from aiding ICE officers limit state and local information sharing with ICE work with their state’s Attorney General to monitor and sue ICE use state funds to help organizations running “Know Your Rights” campaigns and food banks and bail support stop human trafficking by ending transfers from state jails and prisons to ICE strengthen tenant protections including imposing eviction moratoriums during ICE operations Thank you. I promise to continue fighting back in Congress, including supporting legislation like the Melt ICE Act and introducing amendments to end immigration detention. We recently held another Know Your Rights training with the National Lawyers Guild Detroit & Michigan Chapter, about how people can enforce their constitutional rights during encounters with ICE and other law enforcement. I will keep running these trainings, connecting immigrants with legal services, and pushing for a just and humane immigration system—with paths to citizenship for immigrants and asylum-seekers. As a former immigration attorney I know that immigration legal proceedings fall under civil law, not criminal law. Migration is not a crime, and we must push back against the criminalization and dehumanization of immigrants. In solidarity, Rashida P.S. # [Supreme Court smashes Trump tariffs with 6-3 rebuke](https://substack.com/redirect/9df6abb3-83eb-49b4-aa3b-1d0483eb2e3d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The Supreme Court **[delivered a stunning 6-3 rebuke to President Trump](https://substack.com/redirect/9df6abb3-83eb-49b4-aa3b-1d0483eb2e3d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on Friday, ruling that he exceeded his authority by imposing sweeping tariffs on imports from nearly every country under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act, striking down a core pillar of his economic agenda and potentially easing consumer costs amid trade turmoil.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9df6abb3-83eb-49b4-aa3b-1d0483eb2e3d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Majority Rejects Authority:** Chief Justice Roberts wrote the opinion holding IEEPA lacks explicit tariff power, limiting presidential emergency claims on trade.
* **Dissenters Stand Firm:** Justices Thomas, Alito, and Kavanaugh dissented, supporting broader executive flexibility in national security and economic threats.
* **Tariff Scope Targeted:** Decision voids reciprocal duties on Mexico, Canada, China, and global partners, which generated billions in revenue last year.
* **Economic Fallout Looms:** Ruling may trigger refunds to importers, unwind deals, and force policy shifts as stocks rebound from initial market jitters.

# [Silicon Valley trio accused of Iran data leak](https://substack.com/redirect/4c2bce73-44cb-4e6e-bf47-468a03b55a5a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Three Silicon Valley engineers--including two sisters and one husband--were indicted and arrested Thursday for allegedly **[stealing hundreds of sensitive Google trade secrets on processor security and cryptography,](https://substack.com/redirect/4c2bce73-44cb-4e6e-bf47-468a03b55a5a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** then transferring them to unauthorized locations including Iran, federal prosecutors announced in a case raising major national security alarms.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4c2bce73-44cb-4e6e-bf47-468a03b55a5a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Family Conspiracy Uncovered:** The defendants--Samaneh Ghandali (ex-Google), her sister Soroor Ghandali, and husband Mohammadjavad Khosravi--allegedly collaborated to exfiltrate files via third-party platforms and personal devices.
* **Post-Detection Evasion Tactics:** After Google revoked Samaneh's access in August 2023 over suspicious activity, the group continued accessing stolen data and resorted to photographing confidential screens.
* **Dramatic Pre-Travel Act:** On the night before traveling to Iran in December 2023, Samaneh allegedly snapped 24 photos of Khosravi's work computer displaying sensitive processor trade secrets from his employer.
* **Severe Charges Looms:** Each faces up to 10 years per trade secret theft count and 20 years for obstruction of justice, amid DOJ vows to protect U.S. tech from benefiting adversarial nations.

# [Nvidia & OpenAI scrap massive $100 Billion deal](https://substack.com/redirect/1d404a22-d1c8-4b80-8db7-825b1b95697f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Nvidia and OpenAI have **[abandoned their unfinished $100 billion strategic investment pact,](https://substack.com/redirect/1d404a22-d1c8-4b80-8db7-825b1b95697f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/1d404a22-d1c8-4b80-8db7-825b1b95697f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)originally aimed at fueling massive AI infrastructure like the Stargate project, opting instead for a scaled-back $30 billion equity deal amid internal concerns and shifting priorities in the high-stakes AI race.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1d404a22-d1c8-4b80-8db7-825b1b95697f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Deal Collapse Details:** The $100 billion non-binding commitment from September 2025 never finalized into a definitive agreement, stalling over Nvidia's internal hesitations and broader transaction doubts.
* **Shift To Smaller Stake:** Nvidia is nearing finalization on a straightforward $30 billion equity investment in OpenAI, part of a larger funding round potentially exceeding $100 billion overall.
* **Infrastructure Impact:** The pullback affects ambitious plans for gigawatt-scale data centers tied to Nvidia hardware, signaling greater capital discipline in AI buildouts despite ongoing Stargate efforts with Microsoft and others.
* **Broader Tensions Emerge:** Reports highlight OpenAI exploring chip alternatives due to dissatisfaction with some Nvidia offerings, exposing potential rifts between the AI leaders despite continued collaboration.

# [Blue Owl halting redemptions, shakes faith in Private Credit ](https://substack.com/redirect/c085088a-9482-4a1d-b70e-53b3e7f5aa2c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Blue Owl Capital **[restricted quarterly withdrawals](https://substack.com/redirect/c085088a-9482-4a1d-b70e-53b3e7f5aa2c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** from its Blue Owl Capital Corp II fund after heavy redemption requests, selling $1.4 billion in loans near par value to return capital instead, sparking a 10% share drop and **[fresh worries across the $3 trillion private credit sector.](https://substack.com/redirect/5e929be1-d788-4af5-9afc-74b59f911b18?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
* **Redemption Shift Announced:** Blue Owl permanently ends quarterly redemptions for OBDC II, replacing them with periodic distributions from loan repayments, asset sales, and other sources.
* **Major Asset Sale Executed:** Firm sold $1.4 billion in direct-lending investments across three funds at 99.7% of par value to deliver promised liquidity and counter valuation skepticism.
* **Capital Return Target Set:** Executives aim to return about half of investors' capital by year-end through ongoing repayments, earnings, and potential further asset sales.
* **Market Ripples Spread:** Move triggered concerns over private credit risks, with Blue Owl shares hitting a 2.5-year low and declines hitting peers like Ares, Apollo, and Blackstone.

### Blue Owl unloads $1.4B loans to pension giants
Blue Owl Capital sold it's $1.4 billion portfolio of private loans at 99.7% of par value to **[major North American pension funds](https://substack.com/redirect/c0f31967-1115-4e8e-8953-93bedde7d959?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** including Calpers, OMERS, BCI, and its own insurer Kuvare.
* **Strong buyer demand** : Co-founder Craig Packer noted bidders would have purchased multiple times more, calling the near-par sale an extremely strong market validation.
* **Fund-specific allocation:** The $1.4 billion was spread across three vehicles, with $600 million from the retail-focused Blue Owl Capital Corp II to facilitate investor payouts.
* **Broader implications** : Barclays analysts warn frequent similar deals could entangle private credit and insurance sectors more deeply, complicating risk tracking in non-bank lending.

# [Hochul kills robotaxi dream in blow to Waymo](https://substack.com/redirect/c0e82ae5-6a6f-424a-a770-a609a57b1059?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
New York Gov. Kathy Hochul has abandoned her proposal to allow commercial driverless robotaxi services outside New York City **[following fierce pushback from labor unions, rideshare drivers, and transit workers.](https://substack.com/redirect/c0e82ae5-6a6f-424a-a770-a609a57b1059?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/c0e82ae5-6a6f-424a-a770-a609a57b1059?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)The decision delivers a setback to Alphabet's Waymo, which is testing autonomous vehicles with safety drivers in Manhattan and Brooklyn and eyes eventual full driverless rides in the state.
* **Statewide expansion halted** : Hochul withdrew the plan for robotaxi pilots in upstate areas like Buffalo and Rochester after insufficient legislative and stakeholder support.
* **NYC testing unaffected** : Waymo's ongoing permit for human-supervised autonomous vehicle tests in Manhattan and downtown Brooklyn remains active through March.
* **Waymo voices disappointment** : The company expressed commitment to collaborate with lawmakers on future New York deployment, prioritizing safety and transparency.
* **Aggressive national growth** : Waymo plans 2026 commercial driverless launches in Dallas, Denver, Nashville, Orlando, Washington D.C., and London amid rapid U.S. expansion.

Happy Black History Month, Peter. People tell me that Wisconsin isn't ready for a Black governor. It's a phrase I've heard too many times, from people who really ought to know better. David and I have both served Milwaukee — and we're both familiar with artificial limitations being placed on our potential based on the color of our skin and the zipcode we grew up in. Something else we have in common? **We keep proving people wrong and surpassing those limits.** **Here's the truth: when you show up and deliver results that make peoples' lives better, voters judge you based on your work, not what you look like.** And David's record speaks for itself: As County Executive, David has balanced budgets, generated job growth, expanded affordable housing, invested in public health and safety, cut taxes, and led the bipartisan effort to pass Act 12, which delivered more shared revenue to every community in Wisconsin for critical services like police, fire, and EMS. He's also shown what real progress looks like by:
* Cutting county carbon emissions nearly in half
* Standing up for reproductive freedom
* Working to close youth prisons while expanding opportunities for young people

David was the youngest County Executive ever elected in Milwaukee County. He was also the first elected Black County Executive. **Now, David has the opportunity to be Wisconsin's first Black governor._[Will you join me in supporting his campaign by making a donation | | | | | | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE:** February 20, 2026**Contact:** ealbertson@fp1.com
**Alex Mealer Racks up Big Name Endorsements in TX-09**
**Houston, Texas** – Alex Mealer continues to rack up major endorsements in the TX-09 GOP Primary. President Trump, Majority Leader Steve Scalise, Majority Whip Tom Emmer, Congressman Jim Jordan, Congressman Brian Babin, and the National Border Patrol Council have all endorsed Mealer, a wife, mother, and combat veteran.
[**President Donald Trump:**](https://alexandramealer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3bd11eef88d4ef35610a23966&id=f4b771f545&e=2f22037b53)**“** In Congress, she will work hard to Keep our Border SECURE, Stop Migrant Crime, Ensure LAW AND ORDER, Safeguard our Elections, and Defend our always under siege Second Amendment...Alex Mealer has my Complete and Total Endorsement to be the next Representative from Texas’ 9th Congressional District ...SHE WILL NEVER LET YOU DOWN!"
[**Majority Leader Steve Scalise:**](https://alexandramealer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3bd11eef88d4ef35610a23966&id=f20ba10e99&e=2f22037b53)**“** Alex Mealer is the America First, Trump-endorsed candidate we need for Texas’ 9th Congressional District. A West Point graduate, combat veteran, and mom, Alex is a leader and always puts her country first. She fought to secure our elections and as a former business executive and current small business owner, she knows the importance of strengthening our economy. Alex has my complete and total endorsement!”
[**Majority Whip Tom Emmer:**](https://alexandramealer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3bd11eef88d4ef35610a23966&id=143253df43&e=2f22037b53)**“** Alex Mealer is a wife, mother, West Point graduate, Army EOD combat veteran, Harvard JD/MBA, and small business owner who has dedicated her life to serving others. name: Dr. Shirley Weber
subject: What started as one week:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Shirley Weber for Secretary of State 2026
body:
https://drshirleyweber.com/?utm_source=email%20wrapper&utm_medium=email%20wrapper&utm_campaign=email%20wrapper [https://drshirleyweber.com/?utm_source=email%20wrapper&utm_medium=email%20wrapper&utm_campaign=email%20wrapper]
Hey team,

Before the end of the month, I wanted to take the time to commemorate the 100th anniversary of Black History Month with you all.

Black History Month began with the vision of Dr. Carter G. Woodson, who founded what was originally known as Negro History Week.

February was chosen intentionally to honor the birthdays of various Black visionaries, such as Frederick Douglass, W.E.B. Du bois, and more, deeply connected to the struggle for freedom and equality.

What started as a week grew into a movement. That one week expanded into an entire month because the stories, contributions, and brilliance of Black Americans could never be contained in just a few days.

As the founder of the Africana Studies Department at San Diego State University, I have spent much of my life studying, teaching, and uplifting those stories. I believe deeply that understanding our history is essential to shaping our future.

And as one of the few Black constitutional officers in our nation’s history, I carry that legacy with me every day.

Black history is not separate from American history: it is American history. It is a story of resilience, innovation, courage, and community. It is a reminder that progress has always required participation, and that democracy has always been strengthened when more voices are included.

So this month, I’m asking you to join me in something simple but meaningful: Think of 100 things. 100 Black history facts, figures, leaders, artists, educators, organizers, inventors, and everyday heroes whose stories inspire you. One hundred moments that remind you how far we’ve come, and how much possibility still lies ahead.

Team, our history is not just about looking back. It’s about recognizing the shoulders we stand on, and recommitting ourselves to the work of building a more inclusive and representative democracy.

Thank you for reflecting, remembering, and continuing this journey with me.

SHARE A BLACK HISTORY MONTH FACT >> https://secure.ngpvan.com/6ik0yzchsUGZ718gogtd7A2?refcode=260220-rd-em-bhmsurv

In solidarity,

Dr. Shirley N. Weber

[PETITION] Peter,

Wesley just spoke at a hearing for the U.S. House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform, and he made one thing painfully clear:

**The tactics ICE and Department of Homeland Security agents are using are unacceptable. We cannot keep pouring more money into DHS without demanding transparency, accountability, and basic humanity.** [**If you agree, add your name to Wesley's petition NOW.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125793541/602927467/-799883755?ms=em26_260219_dhspet_adv_gq_act___TB_ettx&refcode=em26_260219_dhspet_adv_gq_act___TB_ettx&source=em26_260219_dhspet_adv_gq_act___TB_ettx&utm_campaign=em26_260219_dhspet_adv_gq_act___TB_ettx&utm_medium=email&contactdata=XfB90WJvQLiTfFin5+UEcTERZV9agllGd2y0ZReBCw2FJsvc2eT79Yt6ZuVn5kR1tmM8kbTTKJg7m0QEIFslDcPeo1rtJCUH03GBQI9vkLVG4cyDPTkb50FBbRBiq2ifx+TCMV2jICEwZPjUi8sRCKT38/Pz/JXFIMjPZnotR5M=&refcode2=ee9be63f-8c0e-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDYzODkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZWU5YmU2M2YtOGMwZS1mMTExLWE2OWEtMDAwZDNhNTc1OTNmIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Qf-NmQmx_MJVEGdU6o5N274oIB7wr94ZHp7piWcmbW4=&emci=601b5c6f-b30d-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&emdi=ee9be63f-8c0e-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&ceid=1020964)

After his time serving in Ferguson, Wesley saw firsthand just how hard it was to rebuild trust between communities and law enforcement after that trust had been broken. It took years of policy changes, accountability, and real relationship-building to even begin to repair.

_But now?_

What we're seeing in real time are masked agents deploying militarized tactics on American citizens and using disproportionate force — all under the protection of the Trump administration — _all without any oversight._ That's not how you prioritize safety, and it's certainly not how you build trust between the American people and the government.

There's a simple principle in policing: force must be proportional. You can't respond to a fly swatter with an assault rifle. But that's exactly what we're seeing happen in our communities. Masked agents keep using overwhelming force that leaves families terrified, communities shaken, and American citizens harmed or killed.

Friend, I’m really proud that out of every donation this campaign received on ActBlue in 2025, the average contribution was just $19.88. **About twenty bucks.**
You see, big money usually reigns supreme in Washington. A lot of politicians bankroll their campaigns through huge checks from wealthy people, lobbyists, and corporations. And they get extra support from billionaire-backed Super PACs.
**Not this campaign.** I believe that if we’re going to fight for the working class in the face of oligarchy and corporate greed, we have to do it the right way.
Because let’s be honest: These billionaires and corporations aren’t cutting huge checks for politicians out of the goodness of their hearts. It’s a corrupt deal, and they’re expecting something in return for their donation.
Big Oil donates to members of Congress and they vote to kill clean energy projects. Billionaire tech giants like Elon Musk put millions behind Trump and are rewarded with government contracts and subsidies. Private insurance spreads their money around and Medicare-for-All doesn’t even come up for a vote.
Our grassroots fundraising model is a complete rejection of this legalized corruption: Regular folks like you chip in what you can, when you can. We raise the money we need to win without wavering on our progressive agenda. And as a result, I go to work everyday fighting for the interests of my district and my community, not the highest bidder.
But that means if we’re going to compete with the deep pockets of the billionaires, we need **A LOT** of people to chip in until it adds up.
So, I’m asking you today: Will you help me continue to stay true to our fundamental values by powering this campaign with a donation?

Hey folks,
**Joe Walsh** and I dissect the breaking news: the Supreme Court struck down Trump's tariffs as unconstitutional. Just like that. The centerpiece of his economic agenda? Gone. We got fired up, and yeah--we went deep on what this actually means for your wallet, for Congress, and for the rot at the center of our politics right now.
**Here 's what we got into:**
* [**00:01:07**] We break down the avalanche of bad news hitting Trump at once--GDP sinking, inflation rising, Epstein files back in the headlines--and why this ruling lands at the worst possible time for him.
* [**00:02:20**] Joe unloads: tariffs were never constitutional. Congress knew it. They looked the other way. The Supreme Court did what Republicans refused to do.

body:
Every suppressive action these vengeful partisans take shows their true colors. For all their talk about election integrity, voter ID, and not harming eligible voters, closing legitimate polling places to make it harder to vote only has one logical end result.
Attacks by opponents of voting rights on young voters, mail-in ballots, early voting, and more aren't about integrity and fairness. It's about protecting their own power at any cost and tilting the playing field before the game has even been played.
We must stand up to stop them at every turn. RUSH $35 or more today to help us fight back in North Carolina and beyond >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=022026_2&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
NC Newsline: Amid protests, NC elections board rejects campus voting sites and Sunday voting in several counties [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=022026_2&amount=25]
We're now facing the repercussions of the partisan election takeover laws that went into effect at the end of 2024, Team.
To refresh your memory: After the 2024 elections and the defeat of a MAGA candidate for governor, opponents of voting rights in North Carolina jammed through a bill that took the power of the governor to appoint people to election boards and handed that to the state auditor . It's worth noting that the state auditor is the only statewide elected Republican, with Democrats winning the 2024 races for governor, lieutenant governor, attorney general, and secretary of state.
Now, among massive protests from young voters, the MAGA-fied North Carolina State Elections Board recently shot down proposals to continue having early voting sites on several universities around the state . These weren't new sites either; these were places where North Carolina had provided early voting locations for a decade or more.
This is voter suppression, plain and simple, by making it harder for eligible, registered voters to vote in-person by taking away their polling place. It's another demonstration of how opponents of voting rights in North Carolina are more focused on expanding and cementing their own power than they are in serving the people and having fair elections.
We have to fight these suppressive actions in North Carolina and any other state where opponents of voting rights try to replicate this. These new, highly partisan State Election Board members wouldn't even look the protestors in the eye or engage with their proposals. After the vote, Chairman Francis De Luca threatened to call the cops on students if they didn’t leave.
Need to better understand how this impacts young voters? Western Carolina University in Jackson County, for example, has had a polling place on campus since 2016 that’s been used in five general elections and four primaries, according to a document prepared for the board. The state board voted 3-2 to get rid of it.
Closing the campus voting site would not save money, but “ would create barriers to voting for young, rural residents ,” Jackson County Board member Betsy Swift told the state board. 64% of students don’t have vehicles to drive to the polling place, she said.
Without the on-campus site, the closest polling place for students will be a recreation center nearly two miles away. Students without transportation will have to walk along a four-lane highway and through a meadow to get there.
Voter suppression isn't just black and white photos of eligible voters being turned away from polling places. Voter suppression is making it harder for eligible voters to take part in our elections through onerous ID requirements, closing polling places, taking away voting locations, or ending mail-in voting. Every time someone makes it harder to cast your ballot, voters are suppressed.
It's not going to end until we stop them.

It’s the bedrock of my fight — our Commonwealth’s fight — to defend our fundamental freedoms from the most extreme politicians in the country. And I am furious knowing that — in many states across the country — they have fewer rights today than the day they were born. It’s infuriating that millions of women across the country have had their Constitutional right to choose ripped away. And it’s enraging that all of our kids don’t know if the federal government will have their back, even when they’re following the law. Instead, folks are tip-toeing around the President, worried that if they exercise their Constitutional right to speak up, this Administration will retaliate. **But Derek, I want you to hear me on this: Here in Pennsylvania, we will always defend freedom. The freedom to choose. The freedom to speak out. The freedom to peacefully assemble. The freedom to live your life how you see fit — without the government standing in your way.** [_**Make no mistake: Our freedoms are on the line in this election. name: Adam Schiff
subject: The crook in the Oval Office wants to steal your vote. I won’t let him.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
|
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=9552%2E5257348%2EoRBR0a)
Trump is coming after our elections and voting rights, Derek. Again.
He is intent on dismantling a century of civil and voting rights advancements, the very guardrails of our democracy and the mechanisms that make our elections work. His administration has gone so far as trying to seize control of voter rolls in battleground states, putting detailed, private information about voters at risk.
It’s part of a larger scheme from Republicans to suppress the vote and to find millions of voters to purge from the rolls in an effort to make it difficult for many citizens to vote. One federal judge put a stop to it in California, calling it “unprecedented and illegal.” But this remains a real threat to voters’ rights in other states.

We are beyond alarmed.
The 2009 Endangerment Finding is a scientific declaration under the Clean Air Act that greenhouse gases pose a dangerous threat to public health, providing the legal basis for the EPA to regulate greenhouse gases.
Independent experts warn that weakening these protections would mean more pollution, more asthma attacks, more heat-related illness, and more preventable deaths for millions of people — especially in communities already facing the worst air quality. The costs would fall hardest on working families, children, and seniors.
The administration claims the scientific consensus on climate change has been “overblown.” But the overwhelming body of research — supported by leading scientific institutions — shows the opposite.
Let’s be clear what this is all about. Trump and his cronies are throwing out decades of science to protect the oil and gas executives who bankrolled Trump's presidential campaign. Plain and simple.
Trump can dismantle the science on paper, but the climate crisis is already here. It's in the rising death toll from heatwaves. It's in the floods sweeping away entire neighborhoods. It's in the wildfires that rage longer and burn hotter every year. No political stunt can erase what's happening outside our windows.

clean_body: This is too big to ignore. | We wanted to make sure you saw what former President Obama had to say about Trump's EPA decision last week. He put it simply and plainly: This egregious decision makes all of us less safe, less healthy, and less equipped to fight the climate crisis — all so the fossil fuel industry can pad its profits. There’s no complicated spin here. This is corruption in plain sight. Meanwhile, wildfires are intensifying, floods are devastating communities, and extreme heat is becoming deadlier each year. | Thank you for staying in this fight, — Team JanePAC \---------- Forwarded message --------- 🚨 BREAKING: Trump just launched his most aggressive and harmful attack on climate policy yet | We are beyond alarmed. The 2009 Endangerment Finding is a scientific declaration under the Clean Air Act that greenhouse gases pose a dangerous threat to public health, providing the legal basis for the EPA to regulate greenhouse gases. Independent experts warn that weakening these protections would mean more pollution, more asthma attacks, more heat-related illness, and more preventable deaths for millions of people — especially in communities already facing the worst air quality. The costs would fall hardest on working families, children, and seniors. The administration claims the scientific consensus on climate change has been “overblown.” But the overwhelming body of research — supported by leading scientific institutions — shows the opposite. Let’s be clear what this is all about. Trump and his cronies are throwing out decades of science to protect the oil and gas executives who bankrolled Trump's presidential campaign. Plain and simple. Trump can dismantle the science on paper, but the climate crisis is already here. It's in the rising death toll from heatwaves. It's in the floods sweeping away entire neighborhoods. It's in the wildfires that rage longer and burn hotter every year. No political stunt can erase what's happening outside our windows. In solidarity, — Team JanePAC | = | = = Follow along: | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|--- Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. | | | Peter, **Next week, Donald Trump will stand before Congress and tell working people that everything is fine.** He’ll call the economy “strong” — even as millions lose healthcare, over a trillion dollars is cut from Medicaid and the ACA, and insurance premiums soar. While some of us lie awake wondering how we’ll afford medicine, rent, and groceries this month. He’ll talk about “law and order” — while ICE raids, home invasions, and warrantless arrests terrorize neighborhoods and tear communities apart. He’ll defend a system that funnels obscene wealth and power to billionaires and corporations — and leaves everyone else struggling to survive. **But when he’s done lying, we’ll tell the truth.** [**On Tuesday, February 24th, following Trump's address, Congresswoman Summer Lee will deliver the official Working Families Party State of the Union Response — showing where this country really is right now, why working people are angry, and how our communities are fighting back.**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMbGj-ca0TYSsYMZBvIweYdJxZAP5xLg1YZaKIinIFmIxy3J_jkR2dT0pqt6-7lHktWm7iimn3fawGvEM63R7J6cOLRjURLvet0_clOowOtC3SPkWM4u6Z5mJpFZVZRyJXXpskBhAGIQRHEJNo-0hm0Dj46Dnb3E2KJb4ixuWF127xNxt6rsAZ-CyRLsbzRaCakbRHRJ2v3IavRXuFUmgmA1CLs0rWhZCMVg3KS0oJbKNTDWG5CSkde9NNpf73zB_FZvel4S7EUw63XBWBUD3mtjxYqMY5u_uetoBVEVSBUon/4ob/WkL3xO99S_y7tJhIROoIsQ/h0/h001.0F8H_zNjHm36MK5sh0ej5TINvMvVszkNuWeslzwhHd4) You don’t want to miss it. clean_body: | | | Peter, Next week, Donald Trump will stand before Congress and tell working people that everything is fine. He’ll call the economy “strong” — even as millions lose healthcare, over a trillion dollars is cut from Medicaid and the ACA, and insurance premiums soar. While some of us lie awake wondering how we’ll afford medicine, rent, and groceries this month. He’ll talk about “law and order” — while ICE raids, home invasions, and warrantless arrests terrorize neighborhoods and tear communities apart. He’ll defend a system that funnels obscene wealth and power to billionaires and corporations — and leaves everyone else struggling to survive. But when he’s done lying, we’ll tell the truth. You don’t want to miss it. Sign up now or text SOTU to 30403 to be alerted when Summer goes live. When Summer delivers this response, she won’t be speaking from a distance — she’ll be speaking from her own lived experience. She grew up in a working-class family, attended public schools, and watched her community work hard while still stretching every dollar. She’s lived the stress of juggling bills, navigating a broken healthcare system, and watching jobs disappear while costs rise. She became an organizer and civil rights attorney because she refused to accept that this is just “how it is.” And when she decided to run for office and party insiders told her to step aside and wait her turn, she refused — because communities like hers can’t afford to wait. In Congress, she’s taken on corporate polluters, defended abortion rights, and helped deliver more than $1 billion for housing, clean energy, infrastructure, and union jobs while helping thousands of families get access to healthcare and stable housing. In her response, Summer will speak to what people across this country are feeling: anger at a rigged system, frustration with corporate politicians who protect it, and pride in how our communities are fighting back. She’ll lay out what we deserve: affordable homes , healthcare , good jobs , childcare , and time with family. And she’ll be clear about how we can win it all: taxing the rich , getting big money out of politics , and putting working people first. In solidarity and resistance, Working Families Party Thoughts? body:
Trump just turned an important, productive meeting into a political sideshow.

Peter,

Every year, governors from both parties go to the White House for what's supposed to be a pretty simple and pretty important idea: **sit down, put politics aside, and figure out how to work together to make life better for the people in our states.**

Better jobs. Safer communities. Stronger schools. High quality, affordable healthcare. Those are things we should be focused on delivering for our people.

But now? Trump has single-handedly turned this tradition into a mess, first disinviting all Democratic governors, then seemingly changing his mind, then resuming childish attacks on just two Democratic governors, claiming they’re not "worthy" of an invite. And for no reason at all, a bipartisan tradition was turned into a political loyalty test under Donald Trump.

Andy said it plainly: "It's just a lot of drama, and it's unnecessary."

And, Peter — _Andy's not interested in playing along._

For Governor Beshear, governing isn't a show or a game; **it's about helping the people he represents.** **[If you're tired of the drama and want more leaders who just want to do the work they were Peter,

I’m going to be completely straight with you.

Early voting has already started here in Texas.

We’re now **paying for ad time.** We’re **funding turnout operations.** We’re **pushing digital, mail, and GOTV efforts** to make sure every America First voter shows up.

And I need to say something most campaigns won’t: **_$5 and $10 donations aren’t going to cover what this moment costs._**

_Keeping ads on the air isn’t cheap.
Turning out voters isn’t cheap.
Winning a primary this close to the finish line isn’t cheap._

[**If we’re going to finish strong, I need supporters who can step up at $50, $100, or even more RIGHT NOW.**](http://links.joshcortezfortexas.com/u/click?_t=4e6c34758c664bd584987e77d35da9c1&_m=3c73bcd170b34e939557181b823f69db&_e=krwSxSiXlVZ_kG4Ws7pPh74ZeyuyqdK-rjzfu-ylboGBrL5c978POJiOtKnfCXV75SzgvofASsMT2F8Q19tgmWR5x9s_3CCEsHGorXQ25_gHnDmnOeGfa0pl6QgISerbEgtkSFG1G7kE7EeCV9v4PKOdL1mm3c-CddlpRNjMKK-dO340xpjY6fsfvBgrWkcztk0Os5t7xVTdxNmWVO3ivofgnzMhMJ08Qo2LaVGzFNXUcAYpNZ6dpIbtvCimc5LOlWdm6xEnw7izhY2zPzNKyFeqCaKlRd4fEuzoNNbrL9De-q0jmqcdedYGun2Zu3sdUAJ_Hj62NNIOew9jPHjr7JW84pBynUMd9sckkMTMay7hLYXyGJbm7-1Jo9bezF7BoFtuIHGUpTLT-Nq2cI5vCeIpSCADBRf0SdVZg_6LrbhYx2gmyxpTTq5CaNm0FbV1fMbY6h_f0olITi_8RG5wmCS4okWiUigo3hVxsgVd3wfDVP_5_Nz0iDYBKzFnCCp8dYzkv6XuaWraTlZLxeNL9YIrMJ5cu2iqoW39qD5qK_dv6fX7dLo_8BiBIUXDzFPkb2jtwxB_hkJFIptdGYI6z5IKJRI7ZzvoyT28w4hKs4EC9BMUNuZHrCdATKyyG-Pucbvmd180ytWVsYo0xNEBHBfHhi526XNqiuv7VWnOexxdy_bVq3MpAQH_nvo3oOoTLiZtEkSWSUsqGEc4sBXukFwceNhZuVZ4n4v7pOgd68dNkSVotL0Sm0z0X2Hr8c-FpY2KmzPX9AYJQesP_GtzZw%3D%3D)

Last year, I sued the federal government over Trump’s so-called emergency tariffs. We brought the lawsuit because, under our Constitution, the President doesn’t have the power to impose taxes; only Congress does. Trump’s tariffs raised the cost of groceries, appliances, school supplies, car parts, and everyday goods. For many families, that meant hundreds of dollars more each year just to buy the same basic necessities. **Today, the highest court in the land sided with us in a clear two-thirds majority.**
As your attorney general, I will always fight for Colorado and the rule of law. And that’s what I will do when I’m your governor.
The rule of law matters. _Our Constitution matters._ If the Trump administration breaks the law and their actions hurt Coloradans like they did here, I’ll stand up to them — just like I have in the 50+ lawsuits we’ve filed against this administration since Trump’s 2025 inauguration.

Once public media is gone, there’s no easy way to bring it back

| **The Corporation for Public Broadcasting is shutting down after relentless attacks from Trump and MAGA extremists who know that a free, independent press is a threat to their agenda.**

PBS and NPR have educated generations of Americans, delivered trusted local news, and ensured rural and underserved communities aren’t left in the dark. Once they’re gone, there’s no easy way to bring them back.

**That’s why public figures like Stephen Colbert are speaking out. But public pressure only works if people continue to show up _every day_.**
