name: Tom Leonard
subject: Feb. 20th - Positive Path Newsletter
body:
[](https://sendy.right-strategies.us/l/cve9YluPeAoOO3uAO6KV4g/fQ6Y2OLrMMLKKbOM55E24w/1FQIcuJf4QVTZ83u6MVbRg)
---
Dear Friend,

I hope you're well! Have you ever been to our Upper Peninsula? If you haven't, spoiler alert: it's amazing.

I spent all of last week in the beauty of our U.P ., speaking with local officials and community members, and sharing real solutions.

Here are some highlights from that trip:

• On Tuesday, I met with the doctors and leadership at Schoolcraft Memorial Hospital in Manistique.
• On Wednesday, I had an interview with the Ontonagon Herald.
• On Thursday, I sent out a press release detailing my plan to appoint an ambassador to the Upper Peninsula, which you can read here.
• On Friday, I met with State Representative Karl Bohnak, and showed my support for what he is doing for the U.P., and then watched the U.P. 200!
• On Saturday, I wrapped up my trip by seeing and speaking with some friends from the Marquette County Republican Party.
---
It is always a blessing to spend time in our Upper Peninsula, and I am very happy to have had another chance to speak with local community members and share our positive vision for the state.
**Reforming Taxes to Make Michigan Affordable**
This week, I want to highlight a policy section from our newest edition of 'The Path Forward', focused on affordability and taxes in our state.

Here's the problem:

Half of the Country's top 10 growth states have no income tax or an income tax lower than Michigan's. Eight of the ten have substantially lower property taxes. If we are going to become a growth state, it's time to empower our citizens with a tax cut.

1\. Here's my solution: Immediately cut the income tax to 3.9% and begin the process of phasing it out completely.
2\. Michigan's homeowners pay some of the highest property taxes in the Midwest - second only to Illinois. It's time for real relief. We should offer competitive grants to local governments and schools that consolidate services, keep property tax caps in place even when homes are sold, and require all local millages to go before voters in November of an even year, when turnout is
highest.

These steps would reduce burdens on families and businesses, foster affordability, and make Michigan a growth state.

Read more about this and the rest of the newest edition of 'The Path Forward' at www.tomformichigan.com
**Next-Gen Spotlight**
Our Next-Gen Spotlight for this week is Braydon Zupin. Braydon is a senior at Western Michigan University.
---
"I support Tom because he can win. His determination, knowledge of the issues, and his big heart are unmatched qualities that make him the best gubernatorial candidate Michigan has to offer...I am confident knowing that supporting Tom is supporting Michigan's next governor. As a young man, I finally feel hopeful for the future of this state."

-Braydon Zupin

Thank you, Braydon, for all you do to help our campaign!
**Join the Team!**

It's with your help that results come. We would love to have you join the team!

• Volunteer Today: Sign up for phone banking, door-knocking, events, or hosting a meet-and-greet in your community. Your time makes all the difference! [Sign Up Here](https://sendy.right-strategies.us/l/cve9YluPeAoOO3uAO6KV4g/AT2rUTHLZgAXN8qABq6C3Q/1FQIcuJf4QVTZ83u6MVbRg) and reach out to our Field Director, Tony, for more volunteer opportunities at tony@tomformichigan.com

• Continue sharing our positive vision on social media - follow my X account's, [@Tom4Michigan](https://sendy.right-strategies.us/l/cve9YluPeAoOO3uAO6KV4g/CLO6p56kLA5jKQQwWwfZLA/1FQIcuJf4QVTZ83u6MVbRg) and [@TomLeonard28](https://sendy.right-strategies.us/l/cve9YluPeAoOO3uAO6KV4g/SVOMVG0CZ3rPUJZlPcq763rA/1FQIcuJf4QVTZ83u6MVbRg), my [Facebook page](https://sendy.right-strategies.us/l/cve9YluPeAoOO3uAO6KV4g/K8AlDm5XhU6yWNRIzuJWKA/1FQIcuJf4QVTZ83u6MVbRg), and my [Instagram](https://sendy.right-strategies.us/l/cve9YluPeAoOO3uAO6KV4g/G892Z5A1bThjPOU8RlwIEmTQ/1FQIcuJf4QVTZ83u6MVbRg)
Thank you for the constant support of our vision.

Let's keep the momentum going and make this week another great one!

God bless you and your loved ones. Have a great week.

Best,
**Tom Leonard**
Candidate for Governor
---

To learn more, get involved, and donate visit [www.TomForMichigan.com](https://sendy.right-strategies.us/l/cve9YluPeAoOO3uAO6KV4g/384gvixasI3QxqJSYS9WFw/1FQIcuJf4QVTZ83u6MVbRg)

MONTGOMERY, Ala. (WSFA) - Republican Alabama Sen. Katie Britt has co-sponsored a new bill in Congress with Democratic Sen. Kirsten Gillibrand to protect elderly individuals from financial fraud.

The legislation, called the Guarding Unprotected Aging Retirees from Deception, or GUARD Act, aims to bring online scammers to justice. The bill allows local police departments to allocate certain grant funding towards investigating financial fraud through blockchain technology, which can create a permanent, transparent record of transactions and help law enforcement track stolen funds.

Half of U.S. Space Command headquarters’ workforce will be in Alabama by the end of 2028, U.S. Senator Katie Britt said Friday.

Britt said that commitment came through conversations she had with Secretary of the Air Force Troy Meink and U.S. Space Command Commanding General Stephen Whiting.

“They’re going to work closely with our community partners to ensure that that happens,” Britt said during the Huntsville-Madison County Chamber Washington update at the Von Braun Center.

Tuskegee University is soaring into a new era of aviation excellence thanks to a remarkable $5.29 million federal investment championed by U.S. Senator Katie Britt. This new funding—now signed into law—raises Senator Britt’s total support for Tuskegee’s aviation program to nearly $12 million, marking one of the most significant single investments in the program’s modern history.

This latest allocation directly covers the cost of flight training, removing one of the biggest barriers students face as they pursue aviation careers. It opens the skies—literally—for the next generation of Tuskegee aviators.

Peter,
My name is Mary Peltola, and I want to share with you why I've made the decision to run for the United States Senate in Alaska — and to ask for your support as we begin this journey together.
But if you already understand how important this race and your support are, and you’re ready to become a Founding Donor to our campaign, please use this link to split a contribution today:
secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2026-peltola/founding-donor [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2026-peltola?refcode=022026_3]
CHIP IN NOW >>> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2026-peltola?refcode=022026_3]
Now here’s a bit more on how I came to this decision.
When I was growing up in Bethel, salmon fishing with my father in the summers and dog mushing in the winters, Alaska was a place of abundance.
Now, all across Alaska, we have scarcity.
Multi-national companies are trawling our waters and decimating our fish stocks. The moose, caribou, and migratory birds that used to fill our freezers are harder to find.
So we buy more groceries, where the prices are just crushing Alaska families.
And I've got to tell you, DC people do not care that we are paying 17 bucks for a gallon of milk. They don’t even believe us.
They're focused on their own wallets — not ours.
And when they actually work together on something, it’s usually to help themselves. The rigged system in DC is shutting down Alaska and hurting all of us while politicians and their millionaire and billionaire donors feather their own nest.
It’s why our prices are rising, and our heating bills keep going up. All while the health care and services Alaskans rely on get gutted.
I'm done with politicians getting richer while things get tougher here at home.
Systemic change is the only way to bring down grocery costs, save our fisheries, lower energy prices, and build new housing Alaskans can actually afford.
Systemic change is the only way to fill our homes with abundance again.
My agenda for Alaska will always be: fish, family, freedom. These values have been the core values of my campaigns since the very beginning.
But if we’re going to secure Alaska’s future, we need another priority: fighting corruption.
I'm running for Alaska's Senate seat because it is the fight for our future.
This is going to be one of the closest Senate races of the next election, and I cannot do this alone. There is only one way we’ll be able to win this race... and that is together.
So I am asking:
Please contribute to my campaign for the U.S. Senate and Real Texas PAC today to become a Founding Donor. We are looking for a huge number of day one donors to get our campaign off to a strong start and put us in a position to win. No donation is too small. They will all add up fast. body:
It’s sad.
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=2850%2E21716%2EIhTxI2)
I want to share something with you as a person who sees it up close.
One of the most jarring things I’ve learned since coming to Congress is that for so many of my colleagues on the other side of the aisle, _**the cruelty really is the point.**_
In many cases, they believe the harm they’re inflicting — whether it’s gutting Medicaid and SNAP or targeting vulnerable communities — is aimed at people who don’t vote for them. But the truth is, they’re hurting their own constituents, and they don’t seem to care.
What makes it worse is how much of it is for show.
Behind closed doors, they act one way — and they go out, put on this MAGA character to suck up to daddy, rake in donations from right-wing billionaires, and get clicks and attention on social media.
**It’s sad.**
Because Congress is a place of such profound importance, and there’s a profound potential to do good. It’s why I came here — to govern, lead with compassion, and fight for my neighbors in Delaware. To roll up my sleeves and stay focused on making life easier for working people, even when the other side treats cruelty as a strategy and public office as a show.
[**If you believe that matters — if you want to keep this kind of leadership in Congress — I’m asking you to support my re-election campaign today by pitching in $10, $25, $50, or even $100 today. Your grassroots contribution will help me defend this seat and help Democrats pick up the seats we need to reclaim the House.**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260220-1.BcTMX8&refcode=em20260220-2850&amount=5&t=2&akid=2850%2E21716%2EIhTxI2)

name: Chris Brooks, LCV
subject: Trump dismantles climate change protections — here’s what’s next:
body:
Don’t miss this chance to oppose Trump’s dirty agenda.

If you are unable to see the message below, [click here to view](https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTM0OTgzOTAS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjQwMDgxNDM3NAS2&mt=1&rt=0).
| | | |
---
|
* * *
---
| | | | Peter — Last week, the Trump administration overturned the Endangerment Finding, the EPA action establishing that greenhouse gases are harmful to public health and welfare.
---
| | **The move was paired with eliminating limits on climate pollution from cars and trucks, and could quickly be followed by steps to overturn limits on power plants, industrial pollution, and more — sending our country backwards in time, raising families’ costs, and putting millions of people at risk. **
---
| | In this crucial election year, the environmental movement can’t afford to stay silent. We need to step up our campaign to protect our communities and our health from Trump’s full-scale sellout to the fossil fuel industry.
---
| | We’ve set a goal to raise $20,000 before the end of the month. _Hitting that goal really matters._ It’s what determines how big we can go this year to push back against these dangerous actions.****[**_Don’t wait — renew your LCV membership for just $5 right now >> _**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/3Z0ec-)
---
| | Repealing the Endangerment Finding has serious consequences for our health, our budgets, our air, and our climate. Here’s what it means for you and your family:
---
| |
* **More pollution in the air we breathe.** Asthma attacks, heart disease, and respiratory illnesses will rise, especially in communities near highways and power plants.
* **Climate-heating emissions will skyrocket.** Oil, gas, and coal companies will be free to pump as much carbon and methane emissions into the air as they please, with zero accountability for the harm it will bring to people and our planet.
* **Trump’s EPA is off the hook to act on climate change.** No more safeguards. No limits. The EPA will no longer have the requirement on the books to address climate change and its public health impacts, period.

---
| | | [ RENEW YOUR MEMBERSHIP FOR JUST $5 >> ](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/Ap9dcpZPX~)
---
| | This fall, voters will decide who controls Congress for the next two years. Every poll shows that _Americans have had enough_ of Trump’s devastating rollbacks — and that means corporate polluters are rushing to lock in as many anti-environmental policies as possible before November.
---
| | _**It’s up to us to stop them, Peter.**_****[**_Please, renew your membership for just $5. You’ll make an immediate impact when you help us reach our goal >>_**](https://links.messages.lcv.)
---
| | Thanks for everything you do.
---
| | | | Chris Brooks
Vice President, Membership
League of Conservation Voters

name: Christopher Ahuja for Congress
subject: We Deserve a Democrat Who Will Fight
body:
You're not fighting fascism if you're on its payroll.

| | | | | [|
---](https://chrisahuja.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=67424df89870d1cac00e55f46&id=e8141daa8e&e=53c7d12fc7)
| | | | | | Dear Peter,
CA-32 is a safe Democratic seat. That means we decide what kind of Democrat represents us.At a time when families are struggling with rising costs, immigrant communities feel targeted, and fundamental rights feel fragile, CA-32 deserves visible, vocal leadership.Instead, for the past 30 years, we’ve gotten the same status quo silence from Brad Sherman. His strategy is to say little and stay off the radar. He would rather hide than stand tall during a controversial moment.When ICE agents recently snatched children from our schools, we needed our representative demanding answers.Where was Brad? There were no demands for accountability. On the economy, our representative called Trump’s tariff policy “a reasonable response.” We deserve a Democrat who will push back and put our communities first.Too many politicians in Washington are calculating their careers instead of defending their districts. People want local action on the economy, jobs, healthcare, the environment, and infrastructure. I’m running because representation means standing up for this district. It means challenging policies that hurt working families and choosing people over power.Our community is blessed with small business owners, seniors, creatives, working parents, and young people trying to build a future in one of the most expensive regions in America. We deserve someone who shows up and speaks up.Join us in support of bold, accountable leadership. [**Donate today or join our team to help us build a campaign that fights for this district every single day.**](https://chrisahuja.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=67424df89870d1cac00e55f46&id=c140783941&e=53c7d12fc7) Let’s bring real representation to our community, because we deserve better.
